workflows.name: Back Up n8n Workflows to Google Drive on a Schedule
workflows.prompt: Automatically back up all n8n workflows to a timestamped Google Drive folder on a schedule, and delete older backup folders to manage storage.

workflows.name: Fetch and Enrich Apollo Leads and Sync Verified Contacts to GHL
workflows.prompt: Pull targeted leads from Apollo using ICP filters, enrich each lead, filter for verified contacts, and sync or update them in GoHighLevel/MeldFlow while paginating Apollo results automatically.

workflows.name: B2B Supplier Price Negotiation with Gmail, Notion, and Slack
workflows.prompt: Read supplier data from Google Sheets, draft AI-powered negotiation emails via Gmail, track replies and follow-ups, and log negotiation outcomes to Notion with Slack notifications.

workflows.name: SEO Cannibalization Monitor with Google Search Console and Slack
workflows.prompt: Weekly, pull page-level impressions and average position data from Google Search Console via Databox, analyze it with AI for cannibalization issues, and send SEO risk reports to Slack.

workflows.name: Daily Shopify Order Summary with AI Reports via Slack and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Pull daily Shopify orders, calculate revenue and fulfillment metrics, generate an AI-written summary with Gemini, log results to Google Sheets, and deliver the report via Slack and Gmail.

workflows.name: Publish RSS Articles to LinkedIn and Instagram with AI-Generated Images
workflows.prompt: Detect new RSS feed articles, generate LinkedIn posts, Instagram captions, hashtags, and custom images using OpenAI and Gemini, then publish the content to both platforms automatically.

workflows.name: Daily CVE Digest with EPSS and CISA KEV Prioritization to Slack and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Fetch newly published CVEs from NVD daily, match against a technology watchlist, enrich with EPSS exploit probability and CISA KEV status, and deliver a prioritized digest to Slack and Gmail.

workflows.name: Inventory Forecasting and Auto-Reorder with Google Sheets and Slack
workflows.prompt: Fetch sales history and inventory from Google Sheets, calculate stockout dates and velocity with an AI agent, send critical alerts to Slack, generate purchase orders, and log forecasts automatically.

workflows.name: AI Knowledge Base Assistant with Ollama, PGVector, and Telegram
workflows.prompt: Process uploaded documents into vector embeddings stored in PostgreSQL PGVector using Ollama, then answer user questions submitted via Telegram using RAG-powered AI responses.

workflows.name: Scan Business Cards from Telegram and Save Contacts to Google Contacts
workflows.prompt: Receive business card images via Telegram, extract structured contact information using Mistral OCR and AI, and automatically create or update records in Google Contacts.

workflows.name: Publish LinkedIn Posts from RSS with AI Summarization and Telegram Approval
workflows.prompt: Fetch RSS feed articles, summarize and enrich them using a local Ollama AI model, store results in PostgreSQL, route through a Telegram human-approval step, and publish approved content to LinkedIn.

workflows.name: Extract and Log Outlook Invoices to OneDrive Excel
workflows.prompt: Monitor an Outlook inbox for invoice emails, extract structured invoice data using an AI model, log entries to an Excel file on OneDrive, and archive the original attachments — all within Microsoft 365.

workflows.name: Back Up n8n Workflow JSON Files to Google Drive
workflows.prompt: Automatically export all workflows from an n8n instance via the n8n API and save them as individual JSON files to a dedicated Google Drive folder on a scheduled basis.

workflows.name: Sync Stripe Payments to GoHighLevel CRM with Slack Alerts and Sheets Logging
workflows.prompt: Receive Stripe payment webhook events, update the GoHighLevel CRM pipeline, log payment details to Google Sheets, send a Slack team notification, and email the customer an AI-generated invoice summary.

workflows.name: Generate Podcast Show Notes and Timestamps from Episode Recordings
workflows.prompt: Submit a podcast episode recording URL to automatically transcribe it via WayinVideo, then use an AI model to generate titled show notes sections including SEO description, key takeaways, resources, and timestamped chapters.

workflows.name: Convert RSS Feed Content into AI Avatar Videos and Schedule to Social Media
workflows.prompt: Trigger on new RSS feed items, generate a video script using Claude, create an AI avatar video via HeyGen, retrieve the finished clip, and schedule it to social media platforms through PostPulse.

workflows.name: Daily AI News Digest from Google News to Gmail via Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Each morning, read active news topics from a Google Sheet, fetch fresh articles from Google News RSS feeds, summarize each article using an AI model, and deliver a styled HTML digest email via Gmail.

workflows.name: Convert Telegram Voice Messages into Emails and Calendar Events
workflows.prompt: Receive Telegram voice messages, transcribe them with Whisper, process intent using a local Ollama LLM, and create Gmail emails or Google Calendar events after Telegram-based human approval.

workflows.name: Triage GitHub Issues to Notion with AI Classification and Priority Assignment
workflows.prompt: Listen for new GitHub issue events via webhook, classify each issue by type and priority using an AI model via OpenRouter, write the triage results to a Notion database, and post a summary comment back on the GitHub issue.

workflows.name: Bulk On-Page SEO Analyzer for Up to 100 URLs with CSV Export
workflows.prompt: Accept up to 100 URLs via chat input, fetch each page's HTML and HTTP headers, extract 27+ on-page SEO elements including meta tags, headings, canonical, and Open Graph data, then return a downloadable CSV report.

workflows.name: Mask PII Before AI Analysis with Google Sheets Audit Logs
workflows.prompt: Receive text via webhook, detect and redact PII using regex and context-matching, run AI analysis with OpenAI, and log audit records to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Block Prompt Injection Before AI Agents with Slack and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Screen untrusted webhook inputs for prompt injection, system prompt extraction, and malicious content using deterministic rules and OpenAI before passing to downstream AI agents, with alerts via Slack and logging to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Book HVAC Service Appointments via WhatsApp with GoHighLevel
workflows.prompt: Handle HVAC customer inquiries via WhatsApp, capture contact details, and schedule service appointments using a Gemini AI chatbot integrated with GoHighLevel CRM and calendar.

workflows.name: Chat with Business Knowledge Base Using Gemini and Qdrant
workflows.prompt: Enable businesses to upload documents via a web form, chunk and embed content with Google Gemini, store vectors in Qdrant, and query the knowledge base through an interactive AI agent.

workflows.name: Triage Maintenance Tickets and Assign Vendors with Airtable and Twilio
workflows.prompt: Automatically triage tenant maintenance requests in Airtable, match tickets to contractors by category and postcode, dispatch jobs via Gmail and Twilio SMS, and detect duplicate tickets.

workflows.name: Turn Podium Conversations into a Sales CRM with Claude and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Receive Podium webhook events, classify inbound and outbound messages into funnel stages using Claude AI, update a Google Sheets CRM, trigger drip follow-ups via Gmail, and generate a daily Kanban dashboard.

workflows.name: Write Upwork Proposals from Vollna Alerts Using Claude and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Poll Gmail for Vollna job alert emails, score each listing against skills and budget preferences, and use Claude to generate personalized Upwork cover letters saved as Gmail drafts for one-click review and submission.

workflows.name: Extract and Classify Legal Documents with AI and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Accept documents via webhook, run structured extraction and risk classification with Claude Sonnet, log results to a Google Sheets compliance audit trail, and trigger alerts for high-risk items.

workflows.name: Archive Outlook Email Attachments to OneDrive with SharePoint Logging
workflows.prompt: Poll an Outlook inbox hourly, extract valid attachments, upload them to OneDrive in a structured folder hierarchy, log archive records to SharePoint, and mark processed emails as read.

workflows.name: Create Facebook Posts and Images with Google Gemini
workflows.prompt: Transform raw text and brand guidelines into polished Facebook posts and AI-generated illustrations using Google Gemini, then publish them via the Facebook Graph API.

workflows.name: Deploy n8n Workflows with GitHub-Based Version Control
workflows.prompt: Set up a CI/CD pipeline for n8n workflows using GitHub for version control, enabling backup, validation, and deployment of automations across testing and production environments from a centralized control form.

workflows.name: Generate LinkedIn Carousel PDFs from Form Input
workflows.prompt: Take carousel topic details submitted via a form, generate structured slide content using an AI model, and assemble a branded LinkedIn carousel PDF stored in Google Drive.

workflows.name: Convert Outlook Emails to Planner Tasks and Monitor Microsoft Secure Score
workflows.prompt: Scan Outlook inbox every 30 minutes for actionable IT emails and automatically create Microsoft Planner tasks, while sending weekly Microsoft Secure Score alerts to Teams.

workflows.name: Classify and Label Gmail Emails with Human-in-the-Loop Telegram Feedback
workflows.prompt: Automatically classify incoming Gmail emails using OpenAI, apply Gmail labels, and send uncertain classifications to Telegram for human review to continuously improve the model.

workflows.name: Analyze YouTube Comments with AI and Send Reports via Email
workflows.prompt: Fetch all comments from a YouTube video, analyze sentiment, trends, and content ideas using OpenAI, and deliver a structured report via email and chat.

workflows.name: Generate Weekly Instagram Reels Ideas from Google News Trends via Notion
workflows.prompt: Pull trending topics from Google News RSS feeds, generate weekly Instagram Reel content ideas for a D2C brand using OpenAI, and save them to a Notion database.

workflows.name: Deliver Stripe Digital Purchases via Gmail with Google Drive and Discord Notifications
workflows.prompt: Trigger on a completed Stripe checkout, retrieve purchased file details from Google Drive, email the download to the customer via Gmail, and notify the team on Discord.

workflows.name: Send LinkedIn Connection Invites from Airtable via Unipile on a Schedule
workflows.prompt: Fetch prospect records from Airtable on a weekly schedule and automatically send LinkedIn connection requests via Unipile, updating each record once the invite is sent.

workflows.name: Send Commercial Briefs Before Google Calendar Meetings via Pipedrive and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Poll Google Calendar every 30 minutes for upcoming discovery calls, look up corresponding leads in Pipedrive, and automatically send a commercial brief to attendees via Gmail before the meeting.

workflows.name: Generate Short-Form Social Videos with ElevenLabs and Creatomate
workflows.prompt: Turn any topic into a publishable short-form video by generating a script with Claude, a voiceover with ElevenLabs, and a rendered video with Creatomate, then store it in Google Drive and notify your team via Slack.

workflows.name: Sync PostgreSQL Data to Pinecone Vector Knowledge Base with Gemini
workflows.prompt: Auto-discover PostgreSQL schema, generate Google Gemini embeddings for text-rich table rows, and upsert them into Pinecone with incremental sync tracking and a companion semantic search webhook.

workflows.name: Batch Ad Banner Generator with Google Drive and Sheets
workflows.prompt: Process a Google Sheets job queue to download source images from Google Drive, generate multiple ad banner formats using an AI image model, and upload the results to a designated output folder.

workflows.name: Invoice Reconciliation from Google Drive with OpenAI, Sheets, Slack and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Watch a Google Drive folder for new invoice PDFs, extract structured fields like vendor, amount, and due date using OpenAI, then log results to Google Sheets, send Slack alerts for overdue invoices, and email weekly summaries to Finance via Gmail.

workflows.name: Score RSS Posts for Sales Opportunities and Alert via Slack and Notion
workflows.prompt: Fetch the last 24 hours of RSS posts on a schedule, score each for ICP relevance and buying intent using OpenAI, then route high-signal opportunities to Slack alerts, a Notion database, and a daily digest in a team channel.

workflows.name: Generate Crypto Trading Signals from Binance Data via Telegram
workflows.prompt: Calculate 15+ technical indicators from Binance market data, use an AI model to generate BUY/SELL/HOLD signals with entry, stop-loss, and take-profit levels, then deliver alerts via Telegram and log results to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Monitor Gmail for Compliance Risks with Gemini and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Automatically analyze incoming Gmail messages with Google Gemini to detect compliance risks like fraud, phishing, and data leaks, then log confirmed incidents to Google Sheets and send alert emails to the security team.

workflows.name: Monitor Negative News for Watchlist Companies with SerpAPI, Groq and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Pull a company watchlist from Google Sheets, search recent news via SerpAPI, classify negative sentiment using Groq AI, archive risks in a master database, and send immediate Gmail alerts for confirmed negative news events.

workflows.name: Classify KYC Risk from Form Submissions with OpenAI, Sheets and Slack
workflows.prompt: Capture customer KYC details via an n8n form, send the data to OpenAI for automated risk profiling, log results to Google Sheets, and trigger a Slack alert for any applicants classified as high risk.

workflows.name: Score and Triage Indeed CVs with OCR and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Automatically pick up Indeed application emails via IMAP, extract CV attachments using OCR, score and triage candidates with AI, and log results in Google Sheets to eliminate manual first-pass CV screening.

workflows.name: Classify and Organize Google Drive Documents with Gemini
workflows.prompt: Retrieve files from a Google Drive inbox folder, classify each document using Gemini OCR, then automatically rename, move to the appropriate folder, and log each file for organized document management.

workflows.name: Website Security Audit with AI Reports via Gmail, Slack and WhatsApp
workflows.prompt: Automatically scan websites for security misconfigurations and header vulnerabilities, analyze findings with Claude AI, and distribute detailed security audit reports via Gmail, Slack, and WhatsApp.

workflows.name: Weekly Airtable Task Digest Sent to Slack, Gmail and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Every Friday, collect task records from Airtable, generate an AI-summarized weekly progress report highlighting late or important tasks, and distribute it via Slack, Gmail, and Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Detect Mixpanel Churn Risk and Create HubSpot, ClickUp and Slack Alerts
workflows.prompt: Receive Mixpanel inactivity webhook events, score each customer's churn risk, sync the status to HubSpot, create a prioritized follow-up task in ClickUp, and alert the customer success team on Slack.

workflows.name: Detect Pricing Anomalies in Google Sheets with Slack Alerts
workflows.prompt: Monitor pricing data in Google Sheets for anomalies like missing values or sudden spikes, generate AI-based explanations for flagged rows using Groq, update sheet statuses, and send critical alerts to Slack.

workflows.name: Multilingual HR Chatbot with Voice Support via PostgreSQL and Pinecone
workflows.prompt: Deploy an enterprise HR chatbot supporting 10 Indian languages that identifies employees, retrieves live leave balances from PostgreSQL, searches HR policy documents in Pinecone, and responds via text or voice using ElevenLabs.

workflows.name: Monitor Competitor Pricing with Firecrawl, Airtable, and Slack Alerts
workflows.prompt: Every 6 hours, scrape competitor product pages listed in Airtable using Firecrawl, extract structured pricing data with Anthropic, send priority-based Slack alerts for changes, and log results to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Draft Consulting Proposals from Client URLs with AI
workflows.prompt: Accept a company URL via webhook, scrape website content using Jina AI, and generate a structured 11-section consulting proposal using Anthropic and Google Gemini, returning results as JSON and HTML.

workflows.name: Triage VIP Outlook Emails with Excel and Microsoft To Do
workflows.prompt: Poll Outlook every 5 minutes, check senders against a VIP list in Microsoft Excel, detect urgency using OpenAI, and create Microsoft To Do tasks for urgent VIP emails.

workflows.name: Extract Meeting Decisions and Tasks from Outlook to SharePoint and To Do
workflows.prompt: Poll Outlook for meeting summary emails, extract strategic decisions and action items using OpenAI, log decisions to a SharePoint list, and create Microsoft To Do tasks with normalized due dates.

workflows.name: Weekly Social Media Analytics Report via LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Every Monday, pull 7 days of posts from LinkedIn, X, and Instagram, normalize engagement metrics, log data to Google Sheets, calculate weighted engagement rates, and email an AI-generated HTML strategy report.

workflows.name: Qualify Inbound Email Leads with Gmail and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Receive inbound lead data via webhook, classify leads as HOT, WARM, or COLD using Anthropic Claude, route HOT leads to Gmail and WARM leads to Google Sheets, and return the score in the webhook response.

workflows.name: Find Local Business Leads via Google Maps and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Accept a business type and location via an n8n form, search Google Maps using SearchAPI, parse key business details, and append enriched leads to a Google Sheets spreadsheet.

workflows.name: Qualify and Book AI Sales Calls with LeadConnector CRM
workflows.prompt: Receive inbound lead messages from HighLevel (LeadConnector), retrieve conversation history from Supabase, generate AI replies using OpenAI, and update CRM fields including qualification data and appointment bookings.

workflows.name: Audit Core Web Vitals at Scale with PageSpeed API and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Audit a list of URLs from a CSV or XML sitemap using the Google PageSpeed Insights API, write Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals metrics to a new Google Sheets report, and email a completion summary via Gmail.

workflows.name: Triage and Reply to Gmail with Groq, Slack, and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Monitor unread Gmail messages, classify and draft replies using Groq's LLaMA model, route critical emails to Slack, apply Gmail labels, log triage details to Google Sheets, and send Gmail alerts for critical messages.

workflows.name: Review n8n Workflows from Slack with Claude and GitHub
workflows.prompt: Listen for Slack mentions or DMs containing an n8n workflow URL, fetch the workflow via the n8n API, and reply in-thread with a graded review including Must Fix, Should Fix, and Nice to Have findings using Claude.

workflows.name: Monitor Website Uptime and Send Alerts via UptimeRobot and Multi-Channel Notifications
workflows.prompt: Periodically check UptimeRobot monitor status and Google PageSpeed scores, log results to Google Sheets, and send uptime or downtime alerts via Gmail, Telegram, and WhatsApp with AI-rewritten alert text.

workflows.name: Create and Publish LinkedIn Posts from URLs via Telegram and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Collect article URLs from Telegram or Google Sheets, scrape the page content, use Google Gemini to generate a LinkedIn post draft, request Telegram approval, publish to LinkedIn, and update the publishing status in Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Build Backlink Prospecting Lead Lists with Apify and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Pull search queries and excluded domains from Google Sheets, launch Apify's Link Prospecting Tool across multiple search engines, then append discovered leads and domains back into Google Sheets upon job completion.

workflows.name: Recover Failed Stripe Payments with HighLevel, Gmail, and Google Calendar
workflows.prompt: When Stripe reports a payment failure, look up the customer in HighLevel, generate a discount coupon and email it via Gmail, and create HighLevel follow-up tasks and Google Calendar events to recover the payment.

workflows.name: Manage Telegram Task Reminders with Claude and n8n Data Tables
workflows.prompt: Turn Telegram into a personal task manager by using Anthropic Claude to create, update, list, and delete tasks stored in an n8n Data Table, with daily scheduled summaries and automatic rollover of overdue recurring tasks.

workflows.name: Extract Invoice Data from PDFs with Google Gemini and Log to Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Accept invoice PDFs or images via an n8n Form or Telegram, use Google Gemini to OCR and extract structured invoice fields and line items, append results to Google Sheets, and send confirmation or rejection notifications via Telegram.

workflows.name: Enrich Google Maps Business Leads with Emails Using SerpApi and Airtable
workflows.prompt: Pull Google Maps search queries from Airtable, fetch local business results via SerpApi, scrape contact emails from each business website, and write the enriched records back into Airtable.

workflows.name: Score and Route GoHighLevel Leads with Claude, Slack, and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Receive new GoHighLevel contacts via webhook, use Anthropic Claude to score and classify them as Hot, Warm, or Cold, tag them in GoHighLevel, alert the team in Slack for hot leads, and log all leads with reasoning to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Sync HubSpot Contacts to Klaviyo and Log Activity to Slack and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Receive new HubSpot contact webhooks, map lifecycle stages to Klaviyo lists, create or update the Klaviyo profile and list membership, then notify Slack and log the sync result to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Monitor Shopify Dispatch SLA Breaches with Google Sheets, Slack, and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Hourly, fetch open unfulfilled Shopify orders, detect those that have breached the dispatch SLA window, log breach details to Google Sheets, and send immediate alerts to Slack and Gmail.

workflows.name: Analyze Resume PDFs for ATS Fit via Webhook and OpenRouter
workflows.prompt: Accept a resume PDF and optional job role via webhook, extract the text, send it to an OpenRouter-hosted language model for ATS-style scoring and analysis, and return a structured JSON response.

workflows.name: SaaS Subscription Waste Audit from Gmail to Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: On a monthly schedule, scan Gmail for billing and subscription emails, use OpenAI to extract and classify SaaS spend and potential waste, upsert results into Google Sheets, and send an HTML digest report via Gmail.

workflows.name: Weekly Habit and Mood Insights with Google Sheets and OpenAI
workflows.prompt: Collect daily mood, energy, sleep, stress, focus, and habit check-ins via a form into Google Sheets, then generate a weekly AI-powered personal analytics report with patterns, day comparisons, and experiment suggestions delivered via Gmail.

workflows.name: Customer Support Request Routing to AI Specialist Agents
workflows.prompt: Receive customer support requests via webhook and use an OpenRouter-powered orchestrator agent to classify and route each request to the appropriate Billing, Technical, or Account specialist AI agent, returning a structured JSON response or escalating to human review.

workflows.name: PDF Document Summary Extractor with OCR and Gmail Delivery
workflows.prompt: Accept a PDF upload via a form, extract full text using CoreNexis OCR, generate a structured 5-section summary with OpenAI, convert it into a branded HTML email, and deliver the summary to the user's inbox via Gmail.

workflows.name: LinkedIn Lead Reply Automation with Aimfox, OpenAI, and Slack
workflows.prompt: Receive LinkedIn first-reply webhook events from Aimfox, fetch conversation context, use OpenAI to classify lead intent and draft short replies for interested leads, send replies back via Aimfox, and post outcome notifications to Slack.

workflows.name: Brand-Compliant Instagram Post Publisher with OpenAI, Google Sheets, and S3
workflows.prompt: Daily, read a Google Sheets content calendar, use OpenAI to generate brand-compliant Instagram captions and images, watermark images with a logo, publish posts via the Facebook Graph API, and write publishing results back to Google Sheets with assets stored in S3.

workflows.name: Daily Verge Tech News to LinkedIn Posts with Gemini and Airtable
workflows.prompt: Daily, fetch the latest articles from The Verge RSS feed, use Google Gemini to select and rewrite a story into a formatted LinkedIn post with a generated image, publish the post to LinkedIn, and log the result in Airtable.

workflows.name: Shopify Low-Stock Predictive Alerts with Google Sheets, Slack, and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Daily, calculate Shopify product sales velocity, predict days until stockout for each variant, deduplicate alerts using a Google Sheets log, and send a Slack summary plus a detailed HTML email via Gmail when inventory is critically low.

workflows.name: Send AI-Written Invoice Emails and Payment Reminders via Google Sheets and Gmail
workflows.prompt: When a new row is added to a Google Sheets invoice tracker, generate an HTML invoice PDF via PDFShift, email it via Gmail, schedule overdue reminders at 9am, and allow marking invoices as paid via Telegram with automatic thank-you emails and sheet updates.

workflows.name: Transcribe Meetings and Log Action Items to Notion via AssemblyAI
workflows.prompt: Accept a meeting recording URL via webhook, transcribe it with AssemblyAI, extract summaries, action items, decisions, and next steps using Google Gemini, then create a structured Notion page and post the link to Slack.

workflows.name: Generate and Publish Approved Employee LinkedIn Posts from Blog RSS Feed
workflows.prompt: Scan an RSS blog feed on a schedule, log new posts to Google Sheets, generate role-based LinkedIn draft posts using OpenAI, email approval links via Gmail, then publish approved drafts to LinkedIn and send Slack failure alerts.

workflows.name: Daily AI News Briefing from Google Sheets to Notion and Slack
workflows.prompt: On a weekday morning schedule, pull article URLs from Google Sheets, scrape each page, use Anthropic Claude to generate a structured news briefing, save results to Notion, post a digest to Slack, and log processing results back to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Monitor DOL HR Compliance Updates and Log Action Items to Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Check the US Department of Labor RSS feed hourly, filter for HR-relevant updates, use OpenAI to assess whether each item requires action, and log actionable compliance tasks with summaries and checklists to a Google Sheets tracker.

workflows.name: Score Leads and Send WhatsApp Proposals with HighLevel CRM and Gemini
workflows.prompt: Capture new leads via webhook, enrich them with Apify-powered search, score them using Google Gemini, update HighLevel CRM, send WhatsApp template messages, and handle inbound WhatsApp support with a Gemini agent using Redis memory and Telegram team notifications.

workflows.name: Convert Handwritten Meeting Notes to Google Docs via Gmail
workflows.prompt: Monitor Gmail for unread emails with image attachments, use easybits Extractor to convert handwritten meeting notes into structured data, create a formatted Google Doc in Drive, and reply to the sender with the document link.

workflows.name: Log and Triage Inbound Calls with Twilio, Whisper, Claude, and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Handle Twilio recording-complete webhooks by downloading call audio, transcribing it with OpenAI Whisper, extracting structured insights with Anthropic Claude, logging all calls to Google Sheets, and emailing urgent calls via Gmail.

workflows.name: Iterative Content Drafting Pipeline with Research, Writer, and Reviewer Subworkflows
workflows.prompt: Receive a content topic and brief via webhook, then orchestrate research, writing, and review subworkflows in a loop until a quality score threshold is met or maximum revisions are reached, returning the final content.

workflows.name: Extract and Self-Correct Meeting Action Items Using OpenRouter and Webhooks
workflows.prompt: Receive meeting notes via webhook, extract structured action items using an OpenRouter chat model, validate the output against a strict JSON schema, and iteratively self-correct with feedback using session-based memory to maintain consistency.

workflows.name: Daily AI News Digest Email from Google News via OpenRouter and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Each day, pull the latest AI-related articles from multiple Google News RSS feeds, use an OpenRouter LLM to select and summarize top items, format them into a styled HTML digest, and send it via Gmail.

workflows.name: Collect and Score Job Listings from Multiple Boards into Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Collect job search preferences via an n8n Form, pull listings from Remotive, Arbeitnow, Jobicy, LinkedIn, and Naukri via Apify, then normalize, score, and rank results before writing them to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Qualify LinkedIn Leads and Draft Multi-Step Outreach via Airtable and Apify
workflows.prompt: Pull unprocessed leads from Airtable, enrich them with LinkedIn profile, company, and post data via Apify and Firecrawl, qualify each lead using Claude, and draft a multi-step LinkedIn outreach sequence saved back to Airtable.

workflows.name: Qualify LinkedIn Leads and Draft 3-Step Outreach Sequences via Airtable and Apify
workflows.prompt: Pull unprocessed leads from Airtable, enrich them with LinkedIn, company, website, and post data via Apify and Firecrawl, qualify each lead with Claude, draft a 3-step outreach sequence, enrich phone data via Lusha, and save all results back to Airtable.

workflows.name: Score Shopify Customer Churn Risk and Sync to Klaviyo, Slack, and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Run a weekly Shopify customer churn risk analysis using reorder interval data, sync at-risk customers to Klaviyo segments, and send a CSV summary report via Gmail and Slack.

workflows.name: Detect Dead Shopify Inventory and Send CSV Reports via Gmail and Slack
workflows.prompt: Run a daily comparison of Shopify product stock against recent paid order history to identify dead inventory, then generate a CSV report and distribute it via Gmail and Slack.

workflows.name: Route Social Media Content Reviews with Gemini and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Collect a social media content brief via an n8n form, retrieve brand context from Google Sheets, run a three-stage human-in-the-loop review process using Google Gemini for strategy, drafting, and quality audit, then log the approved post back to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Create and Share Client Folders from Google Sheets to Google Drive
workflows.prompt: Watch a Google Sheets worksheet for new client rows, create or reuse a matching folder structure in Google Drive, share the folder with client email addresses, and write the Drive folder URL back to the sheet.

workflows.name: Summarize RSS Feeds into a Daily Slack Digest
workflows.prompt: Each morning, pull the latest items from an RSS feed, summarize the top 10 into a themed daily digest using OpenAI, and post the result to a Slack channel.

workflows.name: Summarize Web Pages from URLs and Save to Notion
workflows.prompt: Collect a URL via an n8n form, fetch and extract the page content, use OpenAI to generate a 5-bullet summary and 3 suggested tags, and save the result as a new page in a Notion database.

workflows.name: Telegram Chatbot with Memory Using OpenAI
workflows.prompt: Listen for incoming Telegram messages (text and voice), process them through an OpenAI-powered AI agent with per-chat memory, and reply in the same Telegram conversation in the user's language.

workflows.name: Daily Google Alerts Digest via Gmail
workflows.prompt: Fetch multiple Google Alerts RSS feeds daily, use OpenAI to score, summarize, and add sentiment analysis to each alert, then compile the top items into an HTML digest and send it via Gmail.

workflows.name: Draft and Approve Gmail Replies with AI and Approval Dashboard
workflows.prompt: Pull unread Gmail messages, generate AI draft replies using OpenAI, present them in a CustomJS approval dashboard, and send approved replies back through Gmail via webhook.

workflows.name: Draft and Approve Gmail Replies with AI and Approval Dashboard
workflows.prompt: Pull unread Gmail messages, generate AI draft replies using OpenAI, present them in a Tailwind/Alpine approval dashboard via CustomJS, and send approved replies back through Gmail via webhook.

workflows.name: Daily Study Schedule Planner with Google Calendar, Sheets, and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Collect exam details via an n8n Form, use OpenAI to generate a day-by-day study plan, create Google Calendar events for each session, log them to Google Sheets, and email the full schedule to the student via Gmail.

workflows.name: CV Screening and Candidate Scoring with Google Gemini and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Collect job applications and PDF resumes via an n8n Form, use Google Gemini to score and summarize candidates against a job description, store results in an n8n Data Table, and send outcome emails to HR and applicants via Gmail.

workflows.name: Gmail Triage with AI Priority Alerts via Telegram
workflows.prompt: Check Gmail hourly, filter automated senders, use Google Gemini to summarize and classify each email by priority, log results to an n8n Data Table, and send Telegram alerts for high-priority emails.

workflows.name: Weekly AI-Curated RSS Newsletter via Gmail
workflows.prompt: Run weekly to collect and deduplicate articles from configurable RSS feeds, use OpenAI to curate and format them into a themed HTML digest, and send the newsletter to your inbox via Gmail.

workflows.name: Hybrid RAG Search over PDFs with Qdrant and Ollama
workflows.prompt: Ingest a local PDF into Qdrant using Ollama embeddings, then enable hybrid retrieval by querying the collection with both dense vectors and BM25 sparse vectors from a chat interface.

workflows.name: Stale Entra ID Guest Account Governance with SharePoint and Teams
workflows.prompt: Run weekly to detect stale Microsoft Entra ID guest accounts via Microsoft Graph, stage deletions in SharePoint with a 72-hour review window, notify sponsors in Microsoft Teams, and delete overdue accounts while logging audit outcomes.

workflows.name: Bilingual WordPress Blog Post Generator with WPML and OpenAI
workflows.prompt: Use OpenAI to generate an SEO-friendly blog post in Italian and English, publish both versions to WordPress via the REST API, link them as WPML translations, and generate and assign a featured image to both posts.

workflows.name: Lead Enrichment and Classification in Google Sheets with Crawl4AI and Gemini
workflows.prompt: Read unenriched leads from Google Sheets, crawl each company's homepage via Crawl4AI, use Google Gemini to extract company details and generate category and description fields, and write the enriched data back to the sheet.

workflows.name: HubSpot-Triggered AI Outbound Calls with Vapi Call Logging
workflows.prompt: Trigger on HubSpot contact events, validate and normalize the phone number, initiate an AI outbound call via Vapi, poll until the call completes, and log the call summary and recording URL back to HubSpot as a Call activity.

workflows.name: Monitor Google Maps, Yelp, and Tripadvisor Reviews via Apify
workflows.prompt: On a recurring schedule, scrape reviews from Google Maps, Yelp, and Tripadvisor using Apify scrapers, store the results in dedicated Google Sheets tabs, and send a Gmail notification when the collection run completes.

workflows.name: Chat Support Agent with Escalation via Gmail
workflows.prompt: Receive incoming chat messages via webhook, use a Google Gemini-powered agent with a Google Docs knowledge base to answer questions, maintain conversation context, and escalate unresolved issues by summarizing the chat and sending a support email via Gmail.

workflows.name: Repurpose YouTube Videos into Multichannel Content via Gemini
workflows.prompt: Take a YouTube video URL submitted via form, fetch its transcript via RapidAPI, use Google Gemini to generate repurposed content assets, store everything in Google Sheets, and automatically publish the LinkedIn post while logging status and errors.

workflows.name: Crypto Price Alerts and Daily Digest via CoinGecko and Telegram
workflows.prompt: Hourly, fetch price, volume, and change data for a configurable crypto watchlist from CoinGecko, send Telegram alerts when price or volume-spike thresholds are met, log triggered alerts to Google Sheets, and deliver a daily Telegram digest plus respond to /price bot commands.

workflows.name: Generate and Publish SEO Blog Posts to WordPress with Image Generation
workflows.prompt: Receive a blog generation request via webhook with a keyword and target audience, use Google Gemini to write a full SEO-optimized post, generate a featured image with DALL-E 3, publish the post to WordPress, and send a Telegram notification.

workflows.name: Follow Up on Stale Estimates with Gmail Drafts and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Daily, read estimates from Google Sheets, identify stale open items past a configurable threshold, generate a personalized follow-up email draft using Claude, save it as a Gmail draft, and update the sheet with the latest follow-up date and status.

workflows.name: Daily Stale Pull Request Review Digest via GitHub and Slack
workflows.prompt: Every weekday morning, check open pull requests across configured GitHub repositories, calculate review lag for each PR, filter out drafts if configured, and post a ranked stale PR digest to a designated Slack channel.

workflows.name: Book Paid Legal Appointments with Stripe, Google Calendar, and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Automate end-to-end legal appointment booking by accepting client requests via webhook, checking Google Calendar availability, collecting payment via Stripe, creating confirmed calendar events, and sending confirmation emails via Gmail and Telegram reminders.

workflows.name: Recover Failed Stripe Payments with Dunning Emails and Slack Alerts
workflows.prompt: When a Stripe invoice payment fails, generate an escalating dunning email using OpenAI, send it via Gmail, log the attempt to Google Sheets, and notify the owner in Slack when the final reminder threshold is reached.

workflows.name: Send Staged Payment Reminders and Cancel Unpaid Shopify Orders via Gmail
workflows.prompt: Run daily to find unpaid Shopify orders, send staged payment reminder emails via Gmail, automatically cancel and restock long-unpaid orders, email an admin a CSV audit report, and send error alerts on workflow failure.

workflows.name: Send Weekly Brand and Competitor Intelligence Digest to Slack
workflows.prompt: Run weekly to search the web and Reddit for brand, competitor, and industry keywords using Claude web search, synthesize findings into a ranked digest, and post a grouped summary to a Slack channel.

workflows.name: Handle WhatsApp Support and Cal.com Bookings with AI and Google Docs
workflows.prompt: Answer incoming WhatsApp support messages using Google Gemini with company context from Google Docs, automatically create Cal.com bookings when scheduling details are provided, and log each conversation to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: AI-Powered Morning Briefing and Assistant via Slack and Google Workspace
workflows.prompt: Connect Slack with Google Workspace, Cal.com, and OpenWeather to deliver an automated morning briefing with today's schedule, unread emails, upcoming bookings, and local weather, while also handling Slack-based assistant queries using Gemini.

workflows.name: GoHighLevel Client Onboarding with AI-Generated Welcome Emails and Tasks
workflows.prompt: When a GoHighLevel opportunity is marked Won, use Claude to generate a tailored welcome email and onboarding plan, create tasks in GoHighLevel, set up a Google Drive folder, send the email via Gmail, schedule a kickoff in Google Calendar, post a Slack alert, and log details to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Extract and Log Gmail Invoices to Google Sheets with Slack Alerts
workflows.prompt: Poll Gmail every 15 minutes for unread invoice or receipt emails, extract key financial fields using Claude, log new documents to Google Sheets, send Slack alerts for overdue or high-value invoices, and mark processed emails as read.

workflows.name: Qualify Real Estate Leads and Send AI-Drafted Replies via Gmail and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Capture real estate leads via webhook, qualify them and draft a personalized reply using an OpenAI-compatible API, send the reply through Gmail, and log the lead to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Score and Rank Ad Copy Variants with Claude and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Receive ad copy variants via webhook, use Claude to critique and score each variant, append ranked results to Google Sheets, and return the ranked list in the webhook response.

workflows.name: Create Google Calendar Events from Gmail Confirmations Using AI Extraction
workflows.prompt: Monitor labeled Gmail messages, extract event details from email bodies and PDF/image attachments using easybits Extractor, and automatically create Google Calendar events or flag emails for review with a notification.

workflows.name: Summarize Candidate CVs Uploaded to Slack with AI Extraction
workflows.prompt: Listen for CV file uploads in a Slack channel, extract key candidate details using easybits Extractor, and reply in the same thread with a formatted summary and interactive action card.

workflows.name: Extract LinkedIn Candidate Profiles from Slack and Deduplicate in Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Watch a Slack channel for LinkedIn profile screenshots or PDFs, extract structured candidate fields using easybits Extractor, deduplicate against a Google Sheets candidate database, and reply in the thread with a confirmation or duplicate warning.

workflows.name: Generate YouTube Shorts Scripts with TTS Audio and SRT Captions
workflows.prompt: Accept a topic via webhook, generate a punchline-first YouTube Shorts script using OpenAI, convert it to an MP3 voiceover with OpenAI TTS, and transcribe the audio with Whisper to return word-timed SRT captions and base64 audio.

workflows.name: Send Pre-Meeting Context Briefings via Outlook, SharePoint, and Teams
workflows.prompt: Scan VIP Microsoft Outlook calendars every 30 minutes, look up attendee details in Microsoft Entra ID, search SharePoint for related documents, and send a pre-meeting context briefing to a Microsoft Teams chat.

workflows.name: Audit and Optimize Inactive Microsoft 365 Premium Licenses
workflows.prompt: Run a monthly audit of Microsoft 365 licensing via Microsoft Graph, identify inactive users holding premium SKUs while excluding exempted groups and recent hires, optionally downgrade them to a baseline license, and post a results summary to Microsoft Teams.

workflows.name: Generate Veo 3 Short-Form Videos from a Form Using Groq and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Collect a video topic via an n8n form, use Groq to generate a structured video concept and Veo 3 prompt, log content to Google Sheets, generate the video via Vertex AI Veo 3, upload it to Google Drive, and write the Drive URL back to the sheet.

workflows.name: Enrich Google Sheets Contacts with Lusha
workflows.prompt: Read unprocessed contacts from Google Sheets, enrich each person using the Lusha API via LinkedIn URL or name/company lookup, and write email, phone, and job details back to the sheet while marking each row as processed.

workflows.name: Clean Up Stale Entra B2B Guest Accounts with Microsoft Graph and Teams
workflows.prompt: Run weekly to identify inactive Entra ID B2B guest accounts via Microsoft Graph sign-in activity, notify each guest's sponsor via Microsoft Teams, wait 72 hours, delete the accounts, and log deletions to a SharePoint list.

workflows.name: Monitor and Classify Brand Mentions from Instagram and Google with Gemini
workflows.prompt: Collect daily brand mentions from Instagram hashtags and Google Search via Apify, deduplicate them in an n8n Data Table, classify each mention with Google Gemini for sentiment and urgency, and send high-urgency alerts to Slack.

workflows.name: Auto-Assign Unassigned Jira Issues Using Airtable Team Data and AI
workflows.prompt: Trigger on Jira issue create or update events, fetch unassigned issues and team member workloads from Jira and Airtable, then use an AI agent via OpenRouter to select the best assignee and update the Jira issue.

workflows.name: Summarize and Translate YouTube Videos with Supadata and OpenAI
workflows.prompt: Accept a YouTube URL via an n8n form, retrieve the transcript and metadata using Supadata, generate a summary and key points with OpenAI, optionally translate the content, and return a downloadable text file.

workflows.name: Enrich Leads from Google Sheets with LinkedIn, SerpAPI, and Apify
workflows.prompt: Enrich leads stored in Google Sheets by searching and validating LinkedIn profile URLs via SerpAPI and Anthropic, scraping matched profiles with Apify to extract company details and website domains, then saving results back to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Create AI Video Reels from Profile Photos for TikTok and Instagram
workflows.prompt: Receive a webhook with an image prompt and caption, use AtlasCloud to generate a vertical AI video from a profile photo, then publish the reel to TikTok and Instagram via Blotato.

workflows.name: Repurpose RSS Blog Posts into Social Content with OpenAI and Slack
workflows.prompt: Pull the latest post from an RSS feed daily, use OpenAI to rewrite it as an SEO blog post, LinkedIn post, and X/Twitter thread, then log drafts to Google Sheets, create a Gmail draft, and post a preview to Slack.

workflows.name: Social Post Creation and Approval Workflow with Gemini, Slack, and Sheets
workflows.prompt: Collect a social content brief via n8n form, generate strategy angles with Google Gemini and web research, route approvals through Slack, create post copy and AI images via fal.ai, run a final Anthropic review, and log outcomes to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Weekly n8n Security Audit with Custom Checks and Telegram Alerts
workflows.prompt: Run the native n8n security audit plus five custom checks weekly via the n8n API, score the instance 0-100, detect issues like exposed tokens and missing error handlers, and report changes to Telegram.

workflows.name: Build and Manage n8n Workflows from Claude Desktop via MCP
workflows.prompt: Expose an MCP server endpoint for Claude Desktop that enables building new n8n workflows from plain-English prompts using Google Gemini, and provides tools to list, inspect, activate, deactivate, and review workflow executions via the n8n Public API.

workflows.name: Log Receipts from Telegram to Google Sheets and Query Spending with Gemini
workflows.prompt: When a receipt photo is sent to a Telegram bot, extract structured data using Google Gemini and log it to Google Sheets, then expose an MCP server tool so AI clients can query spending by month and category.

workflows.name: Monitor GitHub Actions Budget and Send Usage Alerts to Slack
workflows.prompt: Run daily to fetch GitHub Actions billing and workflow-run data across multiple repositories, calculate budget burn rate and projected spend, and post a summary with threshold alerts to a Slack channel.

workflows.name: Create AI Video Reels from Images and Publish to Social Media via Blotato
workflows.prompt: Accept a webhook with image and video motion prompts, generate a stylized image and vertical video using GPT Image 2 and Seedance, then publish the result to Facebook, TikTok, and Instagram via Blotato.

workflows.name: Generate Freelance Proposal PDFs from Tally Form Submissions via Gmail
workflows.prompt: When a Tally form is submitted, use OpenAI to extract job details from screenshots, reference past projects from Google Sheets and SerpAPI examples, generate a personalized proposal PDF via pdf.co, and email it to the submitter via Gmail.

workflows.name: Republish YouTube Shorts to TikTok via RSS and RapidAPI
workflows.prompt: Hourly, poll a YouTube Shorts playlist RSS feed, deduplicate against an n8n Data Table, download new videos via RapidAPI YouTube Media Downloader, and upload them to TikTok using the Content Posting API.

workflows.name: Extract Purchase Order Data to Excel via Telegram Using OCR and Gemini
workflows.prompt: Accept purchase order PDFs or images sent via Telegram, extract text using PDF parsing or Tesseract OCR, convert it to structured JSON with Google Gemini, validate key fields, and append results to a Microsoft Excel table in OneDrive.

workflows.name: Score Leads and Send WhatsApp Proposals with Gemini, HighLevel and Apify
workflows.prompt: Receive new leads via webhook, enrich them using Apify, score them with Google Gemini, update HighLevel contacts and opportunities, and send personalized WhatsApp messages, with a Gemini-powered support chat agent using Redis memory.

workflows.name: Create LinkedIn News Posts with Gemini, OpenAI Images, and Slack Notifications
workflows.prompt: On a schedule, fetch the latest AI news from NewsAPI, use Google Gemini to draft a LinkedIn post and image prompt, generate an image with OpenAI, publish to LinkedIn via its API, and send status notifications via Gmail and Slack.

workflows.name: Route and Validate Emailed Documents with Gmail and Gemini
workflows.prompt: Monitor Gmail for emails from a specific sender, classify attachments using Google Gemini, extract and validate structured data for bills of lading, invoices, and warranty claims, post results to a webhook, and reply with an HTML confirmation.

workflows.name: Answer Business FAQs with Claude, Supabase pgvector and OpenAI Embeddings
workflows.prompt: Expose a webhook FAQ endpoint that embeds incoming questions with OpenAI, retrieves relevant knowledge base chunks from Supabase pgvector, and uses Claude to answer strictly from that context with citations, returning a structured JSON response.

workflows.name: Back Up and Restore n8n Docker Workflows and Credentials with GitHub and SSH
workflows.prompt: Twice daily, back up all n8n workflows and encrypted credentials from a self-hosted Docker instance to a GitHub repository via SSH, and provide a protected form to restore workflows and credentials by importing JSON backup files.

workflows.name: AI Voice Outreach with Bolna, Groq, Brevo, and Twilio from Airtable
workflows.prompt: Pull contacts from Airtable daily, place outbound AI voice calls via Bolna.ai, analyze transcripts with Groq, then send follow-up emails via Brevo and WhatsApp messages via Twilio for interested contacts, updating call status in Airtable.

workflows.name: SSL Certificate Expiry Monitoring with Jira, Slack, and Gmail Alerts
workflows.prompt: Check SSL certificate expiry daily for domains listed in Google Sheets using ssl-checker.io, create Jira issues and send Slack and Gmail alerts for at-risk certificates, and post a daily digest summary to Slack.

workflows.name: Monthly Payroll Discrepancy Detection with Google Sheets, Slack, and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Run a monthly comparison of current vs. previous payroll data in Google Sheets, flag anomalies such as duplicates or missing employees, alert Finance via Slack and HR via Gmail, and log discrepancies to a Google Sheets audit tab.

workflows.name: Cloud Cost Spike Detection with Jira, Slack, Gmail, and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Pull daily cloud spend from a billing API, compare it to a Google Sheets rolling baseline, and trigger alerts for cost spikes by creating a Jira incident, posting to Slack, emailing Finance via Gmail, and logging results to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Daily AI News YouTube Shorts Creation with Groq, VoiceRSS, Pexels, and Shotstack
workflows.prompt: Daily, fetch the latest AI news RSS headline, generate a script with Groq, create voiceover with VoiceRSS, source stock footage from Pexels, render the video with Shotstack, and upload the finished YouTube Short automatically.

workflows.name: WordPress Article Creation in Author Style with Gemini, Pinecone, and Telegram
workflows.prompt: Ingest WordPress site content into Pinecone and Google Sheets, analyze author writing styles with Gemini, source topic ideas from Reddit and scraped sites via Browserless, route approvals through Telegram, and publish new internally linked posts using Perplexity research.

workflows.name: Competitor Shopify App Review Outreach with Apify, Hunter, and Gmail Drafts
workflows.prompt: Daily, scrape competitor Shopify app reviews via Apify, deduplicate and log new low-rated reviews in Google Sheets, enrich reviewer contacts with Hunter, generate personalized outreach emails with OpenAI, save them as Gmail drafts, and alert in Slack.

workflows.name: Lead Enrichment and Cold Email Icebreaker Generation with Google Sheets and Claude
workflows.prompt: When a new lead row is added to Google Sheets, fetch the company website, extract page text, and use Anthropic Claude to generate a personalized cold-email icebreaker plus an ICP fit score, then write results back to the sheet.

workflows.name: WhatsApp Invoice Parsing and Payment Sync to HubSpot with Gemini and Slack
workflows.prompt: Capture invoice images from WhatsApp, extract structured data with Google Gemini, sync results to HubSpot by creating vendor-payment tasks or closing matching deals, send WhatsApp confirmations, and escalate exceptions to Slack.

workflows.name: SEO-Ready WordPress Blog Draft Generation with Claude, Imagen, and Slack
workflows.prompt: Accept an article brief via webhook, generate a fully-written WordPress draft with SEO metadata using Anthropic Claude, create a featured image with Google Imagen, publish the draft via Rank Math SEO, and notify the team in Slack.

workflows.name: Weekly Facebook and Instagram PDF Performance Reports via Gemini and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Every Monday, pull the previous week's Facebook and Instagram metrics from the Meta Graph API, generate chart images, have Gemini write a narrative analysis, convert a branded HTML report to PDF via PDFShift, and email it via Gmail.

workflows.name: Website Uptime and Content Change Monitoring with HTTP Checks and Slack
workflows.prompt: Every 30 minutes, check a list of URLs for downtime or content changes using HTTP requests and stored workflow state, and post Slack alerts only when a site goes down, changes, or recovers.

workflows.name: Enrich Company Records in Google Sheets with SerpAPI
workflows.prompt: Read company names from a Google Sheets source tab, use SerpAPI web search and Google Gemini to generate structured company details, write enriched data to a second sheet, and mark source rows as processed to prevent reprocessing.

workflows.name: Extract Meeting Action Items and Decisions to Asana and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Ingest meeting audio or transcripts via webhook or schedule, use OpenAI Whisper and GPT to extract summaries, decisions, and action items, create tasks in Asana, log meetings to Google Sheets, and email a recap via SendGrid.

workflows.name: Score and Route Website Leads with Google Sheets and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Receive website form submissions via webhook, normalize and validate contact fields, score intent to assign SLA and priority, log every lead to Google Sheets, and route hot and review leads to the right team via Gmail.

workflows.name: Analyze Google Calendar Patterns and Send Weekly Gmail Digest
workflows.prompt: Pull events from Google Calendar on a weekday schedule, analyze meeting and focus-time patterns using OpenAI, generate optimization recommendations, email a digest via Gmail, and append results to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Score Content Virality with OpenAI, Google Sheets and Slack
workflows.prompt: Accept content submissions via webhook or schedule, pull historical performance from Google Sheets, fetch trend signals via HTTP APIs, use OpenAI to predict a virality score with recommendations, notify the team in Slack, and log results to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Triage Support Emails with Notion Knowledge Base and AI
workflows.prompt: Receive inbound support emails via EmailConnect webhook, filter spam, match messages against a Notion Q&A knowledge base using an AI chat model, then either send a grounded reply or escalate to a human agent by email.

workflows.name: Extract B2B Lead Emails from Google Results with SerpApi and Apify
workflows.prompt: Run scheduled Google searches via SerpApi, scrape top result pages with Apify, use Anthropic Claude to extract email addresses from page text, and send a consolidated report via Gmail, Telegram, and WhatsApp.

workflows.name: Track Google Keyword Rankings with ScraperAPI and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Read keywords from Google Sheets daily, scrape Google Search results via ScraperAPI, store ranking history back in Google Sheets, and email a Gmail digest when notable keyword ranking movements are detected.

workflows.name: Confirm Restaurant Orders by Phone with Supabase and Twilio
workflows.prompt: When a new order is inserted in Supabase, generate a voice confirmation script using Claude and call the customer via Twilio, streaming live ElevenLabs audio without storing an audio file.

workflows.name: Send Daily Marketplace KPI Reports via Slack and Outlook
workflows.prompt: Every day at 10am, fetch KPI statistics from marketplace APIs, compile results into an Excel report, post a summary to Slack, and email the file via Microsoft Outlook.

workflows.name: Cost Engineering RAG from Google Drive PDFs with Pinecone
workflows.prompt: Ingest PDF cost-engineering manuals from Google Drive into a Pinecone vector index using OpenAI embeddings, then answer user questions via a chat webhook using a retrieval-augmented OpenAI agent grounded in the indexed documents.

workflows.name: Capture and Log Trade Instructions from Gmail to Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Watch Gmail for emails with subject 'Trade Instruction', extract structured trade fields using Google Gemini, log valid trades to Google Sheets, reply to the sender with a confirmation, and alert an ops user in Slack on success or failure.

workflows.name: Block Duplicate Vendor Invoice Payments with Google Sheets and Slack
workflows.prompt: Receive vendor invoices via webhook, fingerprint and check them against Google Sheets for duplicates, block matches with Slack alerts and an audit log, and register unique invoices while optionally requesting manager approval via Gmail.

workflows.name: Provision New Hire IT Accounts with Google Workspace and Slack
workflows.prompt: Receive new-hire records via webhook, provision a Google Workspace account, create an onboarding task in Google Tasks, notify the IT team in Slack, email the hiring manager via Gmail, and log the run to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Monitor API Rate Limits and Alert via Slack, Gmail, and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: On a recurring schedule, check an API's rate-limit status via HTTP, calculate usage severity, send Slack and Gmail alerts when thresholds are breached, and log each check to Google Sheets for historical tracking.

workflows.name: Sync New Shopify Customers to Odoo with Multi-Channel Notifications
workflows.prompt: When a new customer is created in Shopify, create or match a contact in Odoo, then send welcome and admin alert notifications via Gmail, SMS, WhatsApp, and Telegram.

workflows.name: Route Real Estate Buyer and Seller Leads with Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Capture real estate leads via an n8n form, use Claude to score and classify each inquiry, route qualified leads to Gmail and Google Sheets, and log early-stage leads to a separate Google Sheets tab.

workflows.name: Law Firm Client Intake Routing with Claude, Gmail, and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Receive client intake form submissions, classify and qualify them by practice area using Claude, route results to Gmail and Google Sheets, and return a confirmation message to the submitter.

workflows.name: Generate Verified Local Leads from Google Maps with Apify and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Scrape Google Maps for business leads using Apify, verify their email addresses via live SMTP checks, and append only valid contacts to a Google Sheets spreadsheet.

workflows.name: Enrich LinkedIn Leads with Apify, OpenAI, and Airtable
workflows.prompt: When a LinkedIn connection request is accepted via Aimfox, notify a Slack channel, scrape profile and company data using Apify, and use OpenAI to generate a lead rating and outreach angles stored in Airtable.

workflows.name: Send AI Interview Briefs from Resumes via Google Sheets and Gmail
workflows.prompt: On a schedule, read candidate rows from Google Sheets, download resume PDFs from Google Drive, extract text, generate HTML interview briefs using OpenAI, and email them to interviewers via Gmail while marking rows as processed.

workflows.name: Track Competitor Ad Messaging Shifts with Adyntel, OpenAI, and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: On a schedule, pull competitor ads from Meta, Google, and LinkedIn via Adyntel, use OpenAI to compare weekly messaging shifts, log results to Google Sheets, and send Slack alerts for high-urgency changes.

workflows.name: Send Daily Outbound Performance Digests via Google Sheets, Claude, and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Every morning, pull outbound campaign data from Google Sheets, use Anthropic Claude to generate a performance summary with sentiment counts and prioritized follow-ups, and email the digest via Gmail.

workflows.name: Generate SEO Tour Blog Posts with Claude, DataForSEO, Google Docs, and Slack
workflows.prompt: Collect tour details via an n8n form, analyze brand voice with Claude, research SEO keywords and PAA questions via DataForSEO, write a structured long-form article, save it to Google Docs, and post the link to Slack.

workflows.name: Collect Web Form Leads and Create HubSpot Contacts with SubmitraX
workflows.prompt: Host an HTML contact form via SubmitraX and an n8n webhook, then sync each form submission to HubSpot as a created or updated contact.

workflows.name: Reply to Instagram and Facebook Comments via Meta Webhooks and DMs
workflows.prompt: Receive Meta webhooks for Instagram and Facebook Page comments, verify the subscription handshake, and automatically post public replies and/or send private DMs to commenters via the Meta Graph API.

workflows.name: Sort Customer Feedback by Rating with Google Sheets and Slack
workflows.prompt: Read new customer feedback rows from Google Sheets, route entries by rating to append positive testimonials to a separate sheet or send negative review alerts to a Slack support channel, then mark each row as processed.

workflows.name: Create LinkedIn Carousel Posts from RSS Blogs with DeepSeek, fal.ai, and Posta
workflows.prompt: Fetch the latest blog post from an RSS feed, generate 5-slide carousel copy with DeepSeek, create AI background images via fal.ai, build a PDF carousel in Posta, and publish it to LinkedIn through a connected Posta account.

workflows.name: Route Chatbot Requests to Human Agents with OpenAI and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Process incoming chat messages using OpenAI to decide whether to answer automatically or escalate to a human agent, tracking session state and escalation status in Google Sheets to mute the bot during active handoffs and re-enable it after a timeout.

workflows.name: Create Daily AI and Blockchain Social Media Posts with SerpAPI and Groq
workflows.prompt: Fetch the latest AI and blockchain headlines from Google News via SerpAPI, draft Twitter/X and LinkedIn posts using Groq Llama, generate a matching image with Pollinations, save content to Google Sheets, and notify Slack daily.

workflows.name: Publish Weekly Google Business Profile Posts Using Perplexity and Supabase
workflows.prompt: Every Monday, research recent automation topics with Perplexity, generate a Google Business Profile post using Anthropic Claude while avoiding recently covered topics stored in Supabase, publish the post, and send a confirmation email via Microsoft Outlook.

workflows.name: Send Weekly Overdue Invoice Reminders via Google Sheets and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Run every Monday to read invoice rows from Google Sheets, filter for unpaid invoices with no prior follow-up that are more than 7 days overdue, send HTML reminder emails via Gmail, and update the sheet to mark each invoice as followed up.

workflows.name: Track Meeting Action Items with Claude, Linear, Slack and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Receive meeting transcripts via webhook, use Anthropic Claude to extract summaries, decisions, and action items, post a digest to Slack, email the organizer via Gmail, and create high-confidence action items as Linear issues.

workflows.name: Score and Route BANT Leads with Groq, Slack and Email
workflows.prompt: Receive lead form submissions via webhook, score each lead using Groq Llama with BANT criteria, and route HOT, MID, or COLD leads to the appropriate Slack channel or SMTP email path based on their tier.

workflows.name: Send Outlook Calendar Reminders to Telegram for Today, Tomorrow and This Week
workflows.prompt: Monitor a Microsoft Outlook calendar on a daily schedule and send Telegram group digest messages for events due today, tomorrow, and within the next week.

workflows.name: Send Monthly P&L Email Reports from Google Sheets via Gmail
workflows.prompt: Run monthly to pull income and expense data from Google Sheets, calculate prior-month profit and loss with budget vs. actual variances, generate an executive HTML report using OpenAI, email it via Gmail, and log key metrics back to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Recover Failed Stripe Payments with Dunning Emails via Gmail and Slack
workflows.prompt: Trigger on failed Stripe invoice payments, use OpenAI to draft escalating dunning emails, send them via Gmail, log outreach attempts to Google Sheets, and notify the billing team in Slack when the final attempt threshold is reached.

workflows.name: Answer Support Questions from a Knowledge Base with OpenAI RAG
workflows.prompt: Power a support chat experience using an OpenAI RAG agent with in-memory vector search to answer questions from an ingested FAQ knowledge base, including a manual ingestion flow that fetches, chunks, embeds, and stores the document for retrieval.

workflows.name: Summarize Sales Calls into GoHighLevel CRM Notes with Deepgram and Gemini
workflows.prompt: Receive an authenticated webhook with an audio file and mobile number, look up the contact in GoHighLevel, transcribe the audio with Deepgram, generate a structured CRM call note using Gemini, and log results to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Publish AI Social Posts from Telegram to LinkedIn, X and Instagram
workflows.prompt: Listen for a Telegram message with an idea or URL, use OpenAI to generate platform-ready captions and an image prompt, create an image via AtlasCloud, then publish the post to LinkedIn, X, and Instagram through Blotato with a Telegram confirmation.

workflows.name: Schedule and Publish Social Content from Google Sheets to Meta and LinkedIn
workflows.prompt: Run daily to read a Google Sheets content calendar, auto-publish pending posts to Instagram and Facebook via the Meta Graph API and to LinkedIn, then update the sheet with posting results.

workflows.name: Create and Publish Social Posts from Telegram Links to LinkedIn, X and Instagram
workflows.prompt: Receive a Telegram message with an idea or URL, extract linked page content, use OpenAI to generate captions for LinkedIn, X, and Instagram plus an image prompt, create an illustration via AtlasCloud, and publish all posts using Blotato.

workflows.name: Extract Invoice Data via Telegram OCR and Save to Google Sheets and Drive
workflows.prompt: Accept invoice images or PDFs via a Telegram bot, extract text using OCR.space, parse structured invoice fields with OpenAI, append the data to Google Sheets, archive the file in Google Drive, and confirm back to the user in Telegram.

workflows.name: Send Pre-Meeting Slack Briefings from Google Calendar and GitHub
workflows.prompt: Check Google Calendar hourly for upcoming meetings, pull related GitHub meeting notes, PRs, and issues, then send each attendee a Slack DM with a pre-meeting briefing five minutes before the event starts.

workflows.name: Qualify Web Leads and Send Replies via Gmail, Google Sheets and Slack
workflows.prompt: Receive lead form submissions via webhook, use Groq to score leads and draft personalized replies, send the reply via Gmail, log the lead to Google Sheets, and post a lead alert to Slack.

workflows.name: Generate SEO-Optimized WordPress Blog Posts with Perplexity and Gemini
workflows.prompt: Collect a research query from an n8n form, research it with Perplexity, draft and format an SEO blog post using OpenRouter and Google Gemini, create a WordPress draft with a featured image, and send a Telegram confirmation.

workflows.name: Create and Upload Daily Faceless YouTube Shorts with Groq
workflows.prompt: Run daily to generate a YouTube Shorts topic and script with Groq, render a faceless vertical video with voiceover and subtitles via SamAutomation, upload it to YouTube, and track the status in Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Send Personalized Birthday Greetings via Gmail, WhatsApp, Telegram and Slack
workflows.prompt: Run daily to pull birthdays from Google Contacts, generate personalized greeting messages with OpenAI, send them via Gmail, WhatsApp Business Cloud, and Telegram based on available contact details, and post a delivery summary to Slack.

workflows.name: Send Daily Product Newsletter via Google Sheets and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Pull today's scheduled products from Google Sheets, build an HTML newsletter email for each product, and send it to all subscribers via Gmail on a daily schedule.

workflows.name: Triage and Route Tasks with Google Sheets, Gmail, Slack, and Google Tasks
workflows.prompt: Receive tasks via webhook, validate and store them in Google Sheets, then run a daily prioritization routine that creates urgent tasks in Google Tasks with Slack alerts and emails an AI-summarized digest of lower-priority items via Gmail.

workflows.name: Create and Triage Support Tickets with HubSpot, reCAPTCHA, and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Validate inbound support form submissions with Google reCAPTCHA, create or update contacts in HubSpot, check for duplicate open tickets, and notify support via Gmail while returning an HTML confirmation to the requester.

workflows.name: Daily AI News RSS Digest via Gmail and Microsoft Excel
workflows.prompt: Pull articles from RSS feeds daily, filter out previously seen items tracked in Microsoft Excel, generate an HTML newsletter digest using OpenAI, and email it to recipients via Gmail.

workflows.name: Screen LinkedIn Jobs and Generate Tailored Resume and Cover Letter PDFs
workflows.prompt: Collect job preferences and resume via a form, scrape LinkedIn job listings with Apify, rank matches using Claude AI, generate tailored resume and cover letter PDFs via DocRaptor, email them to the applicant, and log matches in Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Weekly Project Health Dashboard via Google Sheets and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Every Friday, read project metrics from Google Sheets, calculate Red/Amber/Green health statuses, generate executive summaries using OpenAI, and send a color-coded HTML dashboard email via Gmail with Slack alerts for failures.

workflows.name: Milestone Billing Invoice Automation with Google Sheets, Gmail, and Slack
workflows.prompt: Poll a Google Sheets milestone tracker, calculate invoice amounts for completed milestones, draft invoice messaging with OpenAI, email invoices via Gmail with an approval link, record approvals in Sheets, and notify the accounts team in Slack.

workflows.name: Generate Weekly Blog Content Ideas from RSS Feeds and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Weekly, pull existing blog titles and prior AI ideas from Google Sheets, gather trending headlines from RSS feeds, use OpenAI to generate fresh blog title ideas, and append results to a Google Sheet for editorial review.

workflows.name: Answer Hotel Guest Messages with Slack and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Receive guest messages from a WhatsApp/Viber gateway via webhook, generate multilingual hotel support replies with escalation detection using OpenAI, notify the front desk in Slack when escalation is needed, and log all interactions to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Verify Receipts and Invoices with OpenAI Vision, Slack and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Receive receipt or invoice image URLs via webhook, use OpenAI Vision to extract totals and currency, validate against expected booking values, log results to Google Sheets, and post non-approved cases to Slack for human review.

workflows.name: Detect and Route Customer Escalations to Slack and Linear
workflows.prompt: Receive support messages via webhook from Gmail, Zendesk, Intercom, or HelpScout, use Claude to detect escalation signals and severity, then post alerts to Slack and create Linear tickets for actionable cases.

workflows.name: Block Duplicate Vendor Invoice Payments with Google Sheets, Slack and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Receive vendor invoices via webhook, normalize fields into a fingerprint, check Google Sheets for duplicate payments, log results, notify Slack, and email a Gmail approver for high-value invoices.

workflows.name: Route CI/CD Failure Alerts with AI Diagnosis to Slack, Linear and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Receive CI/CD failure webhooks, classify severity by branch, use OpenAI to generate root-cause diagnosis and remediation steps, then alert Slack, create a Linear issue, log to Google Sheets, and email a summary via Gmail.

workflows.name: Route Purchase Order Approvals and Budget Alerts with Gmail, Slack and Sheets
workflows.prompt: Receive purchase order requests via webhook, email the correct approver via Gmail based on spend tier, check department budgets in Google Sheets, send budget warnings to Slack, log each PO, and confirm submission to the requester.

workflows.name: Scrape Product Prices and Send Market Insights to Google Sheets and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Run daily to scrape product titles and prices from a target website, store results in Google Sheets, generate price statistics and AI market insights, and email a formatted report with a CSV attachment via Gmail.

workflows.name: Log Fireflies Meeting Transcripts to Google Sheets CRM
workflows.prompt: Receive a Fireflies webhook when a meeting is processed, fetch the full transcript, match the attendee to a lead in Google Sheets, and append the transcript to a Conversation Logs tab linked to that lead.

workflows.name: Analyze Google Ads Competitors with Bright Data and AI-Generated Reports
workflows.prompt: Run daily to read keywords from Google Sheets, scrape Google SERP ads via Bright Data, analyze ad messaging with OpenRouter, and deliver an HTML report via Gmail, WhatsApp, and Telegram.

workflows.name: Enrich Existing HubSpot Company Records with Veridion
workflows.prompt: Manually trigger enrichment of HubSpot company records using Veridion, skipping already-enriched records and updating HubSpot with matched firmographic details like industry, location, and company size.

workflows.name: Scrape Business Emails from Google Maps to Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Search Google Maps using a list of queries, extract business website URLs from results, scrape email addresses from each site, and append deduplicated emails to Google Sheets automatically.

workflows.name: Send Re-Engagement Emails to Inactive Users via Supabase and SMTP
workflows.prompt: Run daily to identify inactive users in Supabase, generate personalized re-engagement emails using Claude based on stored brand guidance, send via SMTP, and update user records to prevent duplicate sends.

workflows.name: Find and Save Local Lead Prospects with Google Places and Supabase
workflows.prompt: Accept a webhook with a business vertical and location, find matching businesses via Google Places API, scrape contact emails with Firecrawl, deduplicate against Supabase, store new prospects, and send a digest via Microsoft Outlook.

workflows.name: Track Email Expenses from Gmail with OpenAI and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Monitor Gmail for invoice and receipt emails, extract expense amounts and categories using OpenAI, log results to Google Sheets, and send a Slack alert when an expense exceeds a defined threshold.

workflows.name: Track Google Shopping Price Alerts with ScraperAPI, Airtable and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Run daily to read a product watchlist from Airtable, scrape Google Shopping results via ScraperAPI, store price snapshots in Airtable for history, and email an HTML alert digest via Gmail when prices drop below target.

workflows.name: Score Company Ad Spend from Meta, Google and LinkedIn Ads with Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Read pending companies from Google Sheets, query Adyntel for ad activity across Meta, Google Ads, and LinkedIn, calculate a budget signal score based on ad volume and channel diversity, and write results back to the sheet.

workflows.name: Summarize Daily Standups from Google Sheets with Gemini and Slack
workflows.prompt: Collect standup updates via webhook and store them in Google Sheets, then run daily to summarize submissions using Google Gemini and post the summary or a no-updates notice to a Slack channel.

workflows.name: Assess Salesforce Deal Risk with Gmail, Outlook, OpenAI and Slack
workflows.prompt: Run every six hours to pull open Salesforce opportunities, enrich deals with Gmail and Outlook email context, score deal risk using OpenAI, write assessments back to Salesforce, and notify teams in Slack with email escalation for critical deals.

workflows.name: Daily Executive Financial Briefing via Google Sheets, Notion, and Telegram
workflows.prompt: Every weekday at 7 AM, pull financial KPI data from Google Sheets, generate an executive briefing with OpenAI, save the report to Notion, and deliver it via Telegram with Slack error alerts.

workflows.name: Recover Overdue Invoices with Personalized Gmail Reminders
workflows.prompt: Daily, read overdue invoices from Google Sheets, use OpenAI to draft personalized escalation reminder emails, send them via Gmail, post Slack alerts for exceptions, and log results back to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Send Escalating Invoice Reminders via Notion, Gmail, and Telegram
workflows.prompt: Every morning, fetch unpaid invoices from Notion, calculate overdue severity, use Anthropic Claude to draft escalation-appropriate reminder emails, send via Gmail, update the Notion record, and alert via Telegram for high-risk cases.

workflows.name: Website Downtime Alerts via Email and Telegram
