workflows.prompt: Every minute, send HTTP requests to a list of website URLs and, if a site fails on two consecutive checks, send an email alert and a Telegram notification.

workflows.name: Manage Inventory Reorders with Google Sheets, Slack, and Gmail
workflows.prompt: On a schedule, read inventory and vendor data from Google Sheets, calculate reorder quantities, log pending reorders back to Sheets, post grouped requests to Slack, and send vendor reorder emails via Gmail upon Slack approval.

workflows.name: Flag Delayed Shopify Orders with Slack, Google Sheets, and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Daily, fetch open unfulfilled Shopify orders older than two days, classify them by delay severity, post a digest to Slack, log each order to Google Sheets, and email an HTML summary report via Gmail.

workflows.name: Weekly YouTube Performance Digest via Slack, Gmail, and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Every Monday, fetch recent YouTube video statistics, rank performance, generate an OpenAI insight summary, post a digest to Slack, log metrics to Google Sheets, and email an HTML report via Gmail.

workflows.name: Summarize Daily Slack Standups to Notion and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Every weekday, pull standup messages from a Slack channel, use OpenAI to generate a structured daily digest, save it to Notion, post a summary back to Slack, and append an audit entry to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Send Stripe Payment Invoices via Gmail, Google Drive, and WhatsApp
workflows.prompt: When a Stripe payment succeeds, generate and finalize an invoice, email it via Gmail, store the PDF in Google Drive, and notify an admin via WhatsApp.

workflows.name: WhatsApp Appointment Booking and Rescheduling with Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Receive WhatsApp messages via Meta webhook, use an AI model to detect booking intents and extract appointment details, update Google Sheets, and send confirmation replies to customers on WhatsApp.

workflows.name: Track Slack EOD Updates and Post Executive Summaries to Slack
workflows.prompt: Daily, collect end-of-day updates from active team members via Slack forms, store responses in Google Sheets, and use Google Gemini to generate and post an executive summary back to Slack.

workflows.name: Send Daily Product Newsletters via Gmail and Track Events in Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Daily, read product rows from Google Sheets matching today's send date, send an HTML newsletter via Gmail with tracked links, and log open, click, and unsubscribe events back to Google Sheets via webhook.

workflows.name: Enrich and Route Inbound Leads with You.com, Groq, Notion, and Slack
workflows.prompt: Receive inbound lead details via webhook, enrich the company using You.com search and web scraping, generate a fit score with Groq, route hot leads to Slack, and log all leads to Notion.

workflows.name: Generate VEO3 Videos from Form Ideas and Deliver via Google Drive and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Collect a video idea and style via an n8n Form, use OpenAI to craft an optimized VEO3 prompt, generate an 8-second video with audio via fal.ai, save the MP4 to Google Drive, and email the link via Gmail.

workflows.name: Extract Meeting Insights and Create ClickUp Tasks from Transcripts
workflows.prompt: Collect a meeting transcript via an n8n Form, use OpenAI to extract structured insights and action items, log results to Google Sheets, create ClickUp tasks per action item, and email an HTML brief via Gmail.

workflows.name: Validate Startup Ideas with SWOT Analysis and Email Report
workflows.prompt: Collect a startup idea, industry, and target audience via an n8n Form, generate a SWOT analysis and viability score with Google Gemini, structure the results with Groq, and email the final report via Gmail.

workflows.name: Qualify Product Hunt Leads with Gemini and Log to Google Sheets and GoHighLevel
workflows.prompt: Daily, pull new Product Hunt posts, qualify them with Google Gemini, scrape ICP-matching product websites with Apify to find emails, and write lead data to Google Sheets and GoHighLevel contacts.

workflows.name: Find LinkedIn Engagement Opportunities with Apify, Gemini, and Slack
workflows.prompt: On a schedule, scrape recent LinkedIn posts with Apify, evaluate them against an ICP using Google Gemini, enrich shortlisted authors with profile data, log results to Google Sheets, and send Slack alerts for comment and connection opportunities.

workflows.name: Re-engage Missed Property Viewings via Email and WhatsApp
workflows.prompt: When a Google Calendar viewing event is marked as a no-show, send AI-personalized follow-up messages via Gmail and WhatsApp using Google Gemini, then log the outcome to Google Sheets to recover cold leads.

workflows.name: Answer BigQuery Questions in Microsoft Teams with Natural Language
workflows.prompt: Listen for natural language questions in a Microsoft Teams channel, classify and convert them to safe BigQuery SQL using Claude, execute the query, and return a plain-English summary with a data preview to the Teams channel.

workflows.name: Generate Monthly BigQuery KPI PDF Reports via Email and Teams
workflows.prompt: On a monthly schedule, query KPI data from Google BigQuery, generate a narrative with Claude, populate a Google Docs template, export it as a PDF to OneDrive, and distribute it via Microsoft Outlook email and a Teams summary post.

workflows.name: Send Low-Stock Inventory Reorder Emails from Snowflake via Outlook
workflows.prompt: Query Snowflake daily for items at or below reorder levels, group them by supplier, draft personalized reorder emails with Claude, log details to Google Docs, and send the emails via Microsoft Outlook.

workflows.name: Send Daily RSS News Digest Email via Gmail
workflows.prompt: Aggregate multiple RSS feeds daily, deduplicate articles within a configurable lookback window, and send a formatted HTML digest email to a recipient via Gmail.

workflows.name: Discover and Score Engineering Candidates from GitHub, LinkedIn and Stack Overflow
workflows.prompt: Accept a job description via webhook, use Groq to create a hiring brief, search and score candidates across GitHub, LinkedIn, Stack Overflow, and Hacker News, optionally save results to Supabase, and return a ranked shortlist as JSON.

workflows.name: Generate and Email Daily LinkedIn Post Drafts with Web Research
workflows.prompt: Each morning, select a rotating topic, research it with Tavily web search, generate a LinkedIn post and image prompt using Groq, create a Pollinations.ai image, and email the draft with the image via Gmail.

workflows.name: Score Job Listings and Generate Tailored Cover Letters with AI
workflows.prompt: Scrape job listings from Google Jobs and career sites via Apify on a schedule, score each role against your resume using OpenAI, generate tailored cover letters in Google Docs, and log results to Google Sheets with Gmail error alerts.

workflows.name: Transcribe and Analyze Sales Meetings with Deepgram and Gemini
workflows.prompt: Receive a meeting voice recording via webhook, transcribe it with Deepgram, extract client details and next-step tasks using Google Gemini, update GoHighLevel CRM, post a task summary to Slack, email the client via Gmail, and log the meeting to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Enrich Google Maps Business Leads and Save to Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Scrape Google Maps business listings with Apify, optionally extract email addresses from each business website, and append the enriched lead data to a Google Sheets spreadsheet.

workflows.name: Verify Emails and Phone Numbers in Google Sheets with ApexVerify
workflows.prompt: Watch a Google Sheets lead list for new or updated rows and use ApexVerify to validate email addresses and phone numbers, then write the verification status back to the same sheet.

workflows.name: Create AI Short Videos from Telegram Ideas and Publish to YouTube and TikTok
workflows.prompt: Turn a Telegram message into a short AI-generated video using Google Veo via AtlasCloud, generate an SEO-friendly title with OpenAI, then publish to YouTube and TikTok via Blotato and confirm back in Telegram.

workflows.name: Client Intake Routing and Confirmation with Google Sheets, Gmail, and Twilio
workflows.prompt: Process client intake form submissions by checking service area eligibility, drafting confirmation messages with Claude, logging requests to Google Sheets, sending email confirmations via Gmail, and optionally sending SMS via Twilio.

workflows.name: Create Seedance AI Videos from Telegram and Publish to TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube
workflows.prompt: Take a video idea from Telegram, use OpenAI to generate a Seedance 2.0 prompt and platform-specific captions, create the video via AtlasCloud, then publish it to TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube using Blotato.

workflows.name: Enrich B2B Leads with Tavily Web Search and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Receive a company name via webhook, run Tavily web searches for company info, recent news, and key people, synthesize a structured lead profile using an LLM, append results to Google Sheets, and return the enriched profile in the response.

workflows.name: Repurpose YouTube Shorts to Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok via Telegram
workflows.prompt: When a YouTube Shorts URL is sent to a Telegram bot, download the video via Apify, generate a repost caption with OpenAI, then publish it as a Facebook Reel, Instagram Reel, and TikTok post via Blotato.

workflows.name: Monitor Budget Variance and Send Alerts via Slack and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Run daily to compare department budgets and actual spend from Google Sheets, generate AI-powered root-cause insights with Gemini, send Slack alerts when variance exceeds a threshold, and email a daily summary report via Gmail.

workflows.name: Categorize Gmail Emails, Draft Replies, and Log to Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Monitor Gmail for new emails, use an AI agent to categorize, summarize, and draft a reply for each message, send alerts for high-priority items, and log the analysis and draft details to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Evaluate Vendor Proposal PDFs with OpenAI and Log Results to Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Collect vendor proposal PDFs via an n8n form, extract and analyze text with OpenAI to summarize content and flag risks, log the evaluation to Google Sheets, and send an approval or review notification via Gmail.

workflows.name: Clinic Website Chatbot with OpenAI and Google Sheets Inquiry Logging
workflows.prompt: Receive website chatbot messages via webhook, use OpenAI to generate session-aware receptionist replies, extract structured inquiry details, and log or update visitor records in Google Sheets before returning a response to the widget.

workflows.name: Score Mortgage Loan Risk from Google Drive PDFs and Email Reports
workflows.prompt: Monitor a Google Drive folder for new loan application PDFs, extract text and use OpenAI to score risk and generate an underwriting recommendation, then email the final report via Gmail and post Slack alerts on failures.

workflows.name: Create Vertical AI Videos from Web Articles and Publish to Social Media
workflows.prompt: Accept a web article URL via Telegram, generate a vertical video using OpenAI and the Seedance API, and automatically publish it to TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube through Blotato with platform-specific captions.

workflows.name: Send Weekly Narrative Client Reports via Google Sheets and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Every Friday, pull active client status data from Google Sheets, generate a structured HTML narrative weekly report using Anthropic Claude, and send personalized reports to each client via Gmail.

workflows.name: Daily SEO Digest from Google Search Console to Discord
workflows.prompt: Pull daily Google Search Console performance data, log it to Google Sheets, calculate day-over-day deltas, and post a formatted SEO digest to Discord with heartbeat monitoring and failure alerts.

workflows.name: Sync Google Drive Documents to Pinecone for RAG with Gemini Embeddings
workflows.prompt: Sync files from a Google Drive folder into a Pinecone vector index by extracting text from PDFs, XLSX, and Google Docs, generating embeddings with Google Gemini, and tracking file state in Google Sheets to handle updates and deletions.

workflows.name: Track Lead Callbacks with Tomba, Google Sheets, and Slack
workflows.prompt: Receive new lead details via webhook, look up company phone numbers with Tomba using the lead's domain, update a Google Sheets lead tracker, and send formatted callback alerts to a Slack channel.

workflows.name: Enrich CRM Contacts in Google Sheets with Tomba Firmographic Data
workflows.prompt: Monitor a Google Sheets contacts list for new rows and enrich each contact using Tomba to find email addresses, company firmographics, and phone numbers, then write the enriched data back to the spreadsheet.

workflows.name: Extract and Validate Invoice PDFs to Google Sheets with Gmail Reports
workflows.prompt: Collect invoice PDFs via an n8n Form, extract text and convert it to structured JSON using OpenAI, log invoice headers and line items to Google Sheets, validate totals, and email a formatted extraction report via Gmail.

workflows.name: Classify Workflow Errors with AI and Deduplicate Jira and Slack Alerts
workflows.prompt: Act as a global n8n error handler that classifies execution failures using Anthropic Claude, deduplicates incidents in Jira using hash labels, and posts detailed alerts with execution and Jira links to Slack.

workflows.name: Capture and Deduplicate Inbound Leads via Webhook and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Receive inbound leads via webhook, validate and sanitize data, deduplicate against Google Sheets, and store only clean leads ready for AI-powered email or SMS nurture sequences.

workflows.name: Create SEO Blog Posts from YouTube Videos with Gemini and Google Docs
workflows.prompt: Accept a YouTube URL via webhook, use multiple Gemini AI agents to research the video, write an SEO article, and score it, then auto-publish high-scoring articles to Google Docs or route lower-scoring ones to Telegram for review.

workflows.name: Reply to Instagram Comments with AI, Telegram Approval, and Sheets Logging
workflows.prompt: Monitor new Instagram comments, generate draft replies using Groq, send them to Telegram for YES/NO approval, log decisions in Google Sheets, and post approved replies back to Instagram.

workflows.name: Multi-Agent Research and Publishing Pipeline to Notion
workflows.prompt: Use three specialized AI agents (Researcher, Writer, and Reviewer) to autonomously research a topic, draft content, and quality-check it through a self-correcting review loop, then publish approved content directly to Notion with audit metadata.

workflows.name: Route Human-in-the-Loop Approval Requests via Slack and Postgres
workflows.prompt: Expose a webhook that accepts new approval requests or Slack button callbacks, post interactive Slack Block Kit messages for approvals, and record decisions in a PostgreSQL table.

workflows.name: Create Google Tasks from Meeting Transcripts Using OpenAI and Telegram
workflows.prompt: Monitor a Google Drive folder for new Tactiq transcript files, extract action items using OpenAI, create matching Google Tasks, send Telegram notifications, and log processed transcripts to prevent duplicates.

workflows.name: Publish Daily Social Posts from RSS Feed to LinkedIn, X, and Bluesky
workflows.prompt: Fetch top Hacker News RSS articles daily, use OpenAI to extract insights and ghostwrite platform-specific social posts, then publish the generated content simultaneously to LinkedIn, X, and Bluesky.

workflows.name: Qualify Open House Leads and Send Personalized Follow-Ups via Gmail
workflows.prompt: When a visitor submits a Google Form at an open house, use Gemini AI to score their buying intent as Hot, Warm, or Cold, send a personalized follow-up via Gmail, log all visitors to Google Sheets, and alert the agent for hot leads.

workflows.name: Research, Write, and Publish Blog Posts with Images to Google Drive and Slack
workflows.prompt: On receiving a webhook with a blog title, research the topic with Tavily, generate a long-form HTML article with Gemini, create images via kie.ai, store assets in Google Drive, update a Google Sheets tracker, and notify a Slack user with links.

workflows.name: Book and Confirm Clinic Appointments via WhatsApp, Google Calendar, and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Receive patient booking requests via webhook, generate a unique Booking ID, route online consultations to Google Meet and offline ones to the clinic address, then notify both patient and doctor via Gmail and WhatsApp.

workflows.name: Score and Enrich LinkedIn Leads in Google Sheets with Bright Data
workflows.prompt: When a new lead row is added to Google Sheets, enrich it with LinkedIn person and company data from Bright Data, then use Claude to generate a 0–100 lead score with reasoning and update the sheet status to HOT or DONE.

workflows.name: Track and De-Duplicate Email Leads from Gmail to Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Poll Gmail for new unread emails with a specific label, extract lead details from each message, check Google Sheets for duplicates by email or message ID, and append only new unique leads to a designated spreadsheet.

workflows.name: Review and Coach Jira Ticket Quality with AI Scoring
workflows.prompt: When a new Jira issue (Story, Bug, or Task) is created, use OpenRouter to score ticket quality across five criteria and automatically post a coaching comment back to Jira when the score falls below a configurable threshold.

workflows.name: Export Google Sheets Data to Dropbox as Excel
workflows.prompt: On a recurring schedule, read data from a Google Sheet, convert it to an XLS file, and upload the file to Dropbox.

workflows.name: Transform XML Data and Upload to Dropbox
workflows.prompt: Download an XML file, convert it to JSON, modify specific fields, convert it back to XML, and upload the result to Dropbox.

workflows.name: Telegram Bot to Identify Sticker IDs
workflows.prompt: Listen for incoming Telegram messages and reply with the sticker's file ID if a sticker is detected, or notify the user if no sticker was found in the message.

workflows.name: Webhook Endpoint That Returns XML Response
workflows.prompt: Accept an incoming HTTP request via webhook, generate dummy JSON data, convert it to XML, and return it as the webhook response with the correct XML content type header.

workflows.name: Report Phishing Websites to Steam and Cloudflare
workflows.prompt: Receive phishing site reports via webhook and use Mailgun to send email notifications to Steam and Cloudflare (if the domain is hosted on Cloudflare) to escalate takedown requests.

workflows.name: Process IMAP Email Attachments and Forward as JSON
workflows.prompt: Monitor an IMAP mailbox for new emails, extract and convert XML attachments to JSON, and POST the resulting data to an HTTP endpoint for further processing.

workflows.name: Filter RSS Feed Articles and Send to Webhooks
workflows.prompt: Poll an RSS feed, filter articles by keywords, check MongoDB to ensure only unique links are processed, and route matching articles to different webhook endpoints.

workflows.name: Convert XML to JSON with Attribute Preservation
workflows.prompt: Transform XML data into JSON format while preserving XML attributes by placing them under a dedicated key in the resulting JSON structure.

workflows.name: Back Up n8n Workflows to Nextcloud
workflows.prompt: Periodically back up all n8n workflows to Nextcloud using the n8n REST API, enabling file versioning for recovery and audit purposes.

workflows.name: Save Typeform Submissions to Nextcloud Spreadsheet
workflows.prompt: When a new Typeform submission is received, append the response data as a new row to an existing XLS spreadsheet stored in Nextcloud.

workflows.name: RSS Feed to Telegram Bot Notifications
workflows.prompt: Poll an RSS feed every minute and automatically forward new articles as messages or photos to a Telegram bot, including support for Instagram RSS feeds.

workflows.name: Daily Hacker News 'Show HN' Digest via Email
workflows.prompt: Every day at 1pm, fetch trending 'Show HN' submissions from Hacker News, extract the rank, title, and URL, and send a digest email summarizing the top posts.

workflows.name: Incident Response Workflow - Part 2 (Acknowledge)
workflows.prompt: When an incident is acknowledged via a Mattermost button, update the incident status in PagerDuty and post a follow-up notification to the Mattermost channel.

workflows.name: Incident Response Workflow - Part 3 (Resolve)
workflows.prompt: When an incident resolve button is clicked in Mattermost, update the incident status in PagerDuty, close the associated Jira ticket, and notify the team in Mattermost.

workflows.name: Generate and Insert Test Data into PostgreSQL
workflows.prompt: On a scheduled interval, generate sample data using a JavaScript function and insert it into a specified PostgreSQL database table for testing or monitoring purposes.

workflows.name: Error Workflow Notifications via Mattermost and SMS

workflows.prompt: Every Monday, pull per-client analytics from Umami, generate branded SEO and AIO reports using Groq, email HTML reports to clients, post Slack summaries via webhook, and store results in Airtable.

workflows.name: Stale GitHub Branch Cleanup Reports with Slack Notifications
workflows.prompt: Weekly, scan configured GitHub repositories for merged-but-not-deleted and stale branches, post a cleanup report to Slack, and optionally auto-delete a capped number of qualifying branches.

workflows.name: Zabbix Infrastructure Health Analysis with Gemini and PostgreSQL
workflows.prompt: Expose a secured webhook that routes infrastructure questions to an AI agent, which queries a Zabbix PostgreSQL database for host, alert, and performance metrics and returns a Markdown response with inline SVG charts using Gemini and Redis for memory.

workflows.name: Track Customer Support Hiring Signals with Coresignal and HubSpot
workflows.prompt: Pull HubSpot companies weekly, search Coresignal job ads via Elasticsearch for customer support roles by company domain, maintain job snapshot tables in n8n Data Tables, and update HubSpot company properties with job-signal metrics.

workflows.name: Score Resume Authenticity with GitHub, LinkedIn, and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Accept resume submissions via webhook or schedule, extract verifiable claims, cross-check them against GitHub and LinkedIn data using OpenAI, calculate an authenticity score, log results to Google Sheets, and email a summary via SendGrid.

workflows.name: Build a Slack Knowledge Graph with Neo4j and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Ingest Slack messages via webhook or schedule, use Anthropic Claude to extract entities and relationships, store the resulting knowledge graph in Neo4j, and append an audit log to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Review Business Ideas with a Virtual Board of Directors
workflows.prompt: Accept a business idea via chat, send it to five executive AI agents (CMO, CFO, CPO, COO, CLO) powered by Anthropic Claude, and synthesize their structured feedback into board meeting minutes with a final verdict.

workflows.name: Score Sales Outreach Opportunities from RSS Feeds with Gmail
workflows.prompt: Read an RSS feed weekly, use Anthropic Claude to score recent items as sales outreach opportunities against your product offering, and email a ranked digest of the best matches via Gmail.

workflows.name: Route Law Firm Client Intakes with AI and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Receive client intake form submissions, classify and qualify each matter using Anthropic Claude, log results to Google Sheets, email the intake team for qualified matters via Gmail, and return a neutral confirmation to the submitter.

workflows.name: Send White-Label Ad Performance Reports via Gmail and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Pull ad performance data from a configurable platform API monthly, generate a client-friendly narrative with Anthropic Claude, email a branded HTML report via Gmail, and log results to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Commodity Investment Briefings from CNBC RSS via Slack
workflows.prompt: Pull commodity headlines from the CNBC RSS feed, filter and rank the most relevant items, generate an actionable investment briefing using Google Gemini, and post it to a Slack channel with error notifications on failure.

workflows.name: Track Investor Behavior with NewsAPI, Gemini, and Slack
workflows.prompt: Capture investor buy/sell actions via an n8n Form, fetch related market news from NewsAPI, generate a behavioral reflection with Google Gemini, send it via Gmail and Slack, store it in an n8n Data Table, and post a weekly Slack summary using Groq.

workflows.name: Track Commodity News Sentiment with Groq, Google Sheets, and Slack
workflows.prompt: Daily, fetch commodity articles from OilPrice and Invezz RSS feeds, classify sentiment and extract details using a Groq LLM, append results to Google Sheets, and post a Slack alert when aggregated sentiment crosses a threshold.

workflows.name: Score Instagram Hashtag Engagement with Apify, Telegram, and Airtable
workflows.prompt: Daily, fetch Instagram hashtag posts via Apify, compute weighted engagement scores, send a top-10 HTML report to a Telegram channel, and upsert scored posts into Airtable.

workflows.name: Handle Order Status Webhooks with Microsoft SQL Server and Email
workflows.prompt: Receive order status update webhooks, validate and normalize the payload, log rejected orders to Microsoft SQL Server, and send rejection notification emails via SMTP.

workflows.name: Send Scored Media Monitoring Digests from RSS Feeds via Email
workflows.prompt: Hourly, read multiple RSS feeds, apply topic matching and relevance scoring with sentiment and entity tagging, deduplicate results, and send scored HTML email digests via SMTP when new matches are found.

workflows.name: Track Gold Price Changes and Send Slack Alerts with Gemini
workflows.prompt: Daily, fetch gold prices in INR from MetalpriceAPI, log them to an n8n Data Table, calculate day-over-day changes, and use Google Gemini to send Slack alerts for significant moves and a weekly trend report.

workflows.name: Predict Competitor Ad Launch Cycles with Adyntel, OpenAI, and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: On a schedule, pull competitor ads from Meta, Google, and LinkedIn via Adyntel, use OpenAI to predict ad launch timing and seasonality patterns, and append the resulting timeline and predictions to a Google Sheets launch calendar.

workflows.name: Detect Competitor Product Launches from Ads with Adyntel and OpenAI
workflows.prompt: On a schedule, scan competitor ads across Meta, Google, and LinkedIn via Adyntel, extract newly appearing terms from ad copy, and use OpenAI to classify potential product launch signals while logging results to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Simulate Investment Scenarios with Groq and Google News RSS Feeds
workflows.prompt: Receive investment inputs via webhook, calculate projected returns and risk profiles, pull relevant Google News RSS headlines for market context, and use Groq to generate a structured JSON analysis with investment suggestions.

workflows.name: Fetch Full Google Ads Account Audit Data as Merged JSON
workflows.prompt: Pull comprehensive Google Ads reporting data for a single account via the Google Ads API, including campaign, ad group, keyword, ad, and search-term performance over a specified date range, and return everything as one merged JSON object.

workflows.name: Generate and Store AI Images with Cloudflare Workers AI and Supabase
workflows.prompt: Listen for new rows in a Supabase image_jobs table, expand prompts using Anthropic Claude, generate images with Cloudflare Workers AI (FLUX), upload results to Supabase Storage, and write the public image URL back to the original record.

workflows.name: Generate ZUGFeRD/Factur-X E-Invoices from Webhook Orders via PolyDoc
workflows.prompt: Receive order data via webhook, validate and calculate line totals and VAT, generate a compliant ZUGFeRD/Factur-X PDF/A-3 e-invoice with embedded XML using PolyDoc, email the PDF to the buyer, and return it in the webhook response.

workflows.name: Multi-Provider LLM Router for Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and OpenAI
workflows.prompt: Act as a reusable sub-workflow that accepts a text prompt, routes it to the specified LLM provider (Anthropic, Google Gemini, Mistral, or OpenAI), and returns a normalized response including estimated token usage and cost.

workflows.name: Save Web Page Research Cards to Notion and Google Sheets with OpenAI
workflows.prompt: Accept a URL via an n8n form, fetch and extract the page's main text, use OpenAI to generate a structured research card with summary, tags, quotes, actions, sentiment, and reading time, then save to Notion and log it in Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Aggregate Shipment Tracking Statuses from FedEx, UPS and DHL
workflows.prompt: Run every 15 minutes to fetch active shipments from an n8n Data Table, query FedEx, UPS, or DHL tracking APIs with circuit-breaker protection, normalize each carrier response into a shared status schema, and upsert the latest status back into the table.

workflows.name: Monitor Binance Futures Funding Rates and Alert via Telegram
workflows.prompt: Run hourly to scan Binance Futures USDT perpetual contracts, check each symbol's funding rate against warning and critical thresholds, and send formatted alert messages to Telegram when high funding rates are detected.

workflows.name: Find ICP-Matched Companies and Decision-Makers with Agent Jesse
workflows.prompt: Collect product and ICP details via an n8n form, submit a research job to Agent Jesse to find matching companies or people, poll for results, and output a scored lead list with a generated CSV file.

workflows.name: Sync Website FAQs to Pinecone Weekly Using OpenAI Embeddings
workflows.prompt: Run weekly to crawl a website sitemap, scrape each page, generate FAQs with OpenAI, embed the Q&A content using OpenAI embeddings, and upsert the vectors into Pinecone to maintain an up-to-date RAG knowledge base.

workflows.name: Sync Paid Shopify Order Contacts to Odoo and Remove Duplicates
workflows.prompt: Trigger on paid Shopify orders, search Odoo Contacts for existing matching records, create new contacts when none are found, and run a duplicate-check branch to prevent redundant entries.

workflows.name: Scrape Ecommerce Product Data into Google Sheets with Gemini Vision
workflows.prompt: Read a list of product page URLs from Google Sheets, scrape each page with ScrapingBee, use Google Gemini to extract structured product data from screenshots with an HTML fallback, and append results back to the sheet.

workflows.name: Launch 5-Day Ecommerce Social Campaigns with DeepSeek and Posta
workflows.prompt: Fetch product data and images via HTTP, generate a 5-day caption series using DeepSeek, upload media to Posta, and schedule posts across active social accounts with one account per platform.

workflows.name: Log Gold and Silver Prices to Google Sheets and Email Insights via Gmail
workflows.prompt: Fetch daily Gold and Silver prices from GoldAPI, log them to Google Sheets, summarize historical monthly averages, generate seasonal insights with Groq, build QuickChart bar charts, and email a formatted report via Gmail.

workflows.name: Track Personal Financial Health with Google Sheets and Slack
workflows.prompt: Collect income, savings, investment, and expense data via a form, calculate a financial health score with AI-generated advice, store results in Google Sheets, and post a formatted summary and expense alerts to Slack.

workflows.name: Commodity Portfolio Diversification Analysis with Google Sheets and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Read a gold/silver/oil portfolio from Google Sheets, fetch real-time commodity prices from GoldAPI, EIA, and Twelve Data, calculate allocation and concentration risk, generate an AI analysis, and email an HTML diversification report via Gmail.

workflows.name: Reindex Markdown Documentation into Supabase pgvector
workflows.prompt: Fetch Markdown documentation from an HTTP API, chunk and embed content via a Supabase Edge Function, upsert vectors into a Supabase Postgres pgvector table, and delete stale chunks on a daily schedule or webhook trigger.

workflows.name: Manage Construction Work Permits with Google Sheets and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Accept construction work permit requests via webhook, log them to Google Sheets, use AI to detect scheduling conflicts with active permits, route requests for supervisor approval via Gmail, and send expiry reminders automatically.

workflows.name: Triage Construction Incidents with Slack, Gmail, and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Ingest construction incident webhooks, classify each incident by type and urgency using OpenAI, route alerts to Slack and Gmail, log all incidents to Google Sheets, and send a daily Slack digest of incident activity.

workflows.name: Bulk Certificate and Contract PDF Generation with Excel and OneDrive
workflows.prompt: Every Monday, read pending rows from Microsoft Excel, generate certificate and contract PDFs in bulk using Carbone templates from SharePoint, upload files to OneDrive, post a summary to Microsoft Teams, and mark rows as completed via Microsoft Graph.

workflows.name: Scrape SEEK.com.au Jobs Daily to Sheets, Airtable, Slack, Telegram, and Discord
workflows.prompt: Run a daily SEEK.com.au job search via Apify, deduplicate new listings, store results in Google Sheets and Airtable, and send digest notifications across Slack, Telegram, Discord, and Gmail.

workflows.name: Quote Freight Shipments via WhatsApp with HighLevel and Warp API
workflows.prompt: Receive WhatsApp messages, verify senders in HighLevel, use Gemini AI with Redis chat memory to collect shipment details conversationally, request LTL freight quotes from the Warp API with commission applied, and reply with the final quote.

workflows.name: Check JWT Security of API Endpoints with Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Read API endpoints and JWT tokens from Google Sheets, test each endpoint with multiple token scenarios via HTTP requests, and write a risk-scored security summary back to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Monitor Website Changes with Screenshots and Email Alerts
workflows.prompt: Check a website URL every 6 hours for content changes by hashing normalized HTML, and when a change is detected, capture a full-page screenshot with PolyDoc and email it as a PNG attachment.

workflows.name: Schedule and Publish Threads Posts from Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Run hourly to read the next pending post from Google Sheets, publish it to Threads via the Threads Graph API, and update the sheet with published or failed status, timestamps, and error details.

workflows.name: Extract Tracking Numbers from Gmail PDF Attachments to Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Monitor unread Gmail messages with PDF attachments, send PDFs to okraPDF for OCR parsing, extract tracking numbers from the parsed text, and append the results as new rows in Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Fetch and Parse Amazon SP-API Reports into Structured TSV Rows
workflows.prompt: Manually request an Amazon Selling Partner API report, poll until it is ready, download and optionally decompress the GZIP document, and parse the TSV contents into individual structured items.

workflows.name: Unpublish NSFW ImageKit Uploads Using GPT-4o Vision
workflows.prompt: Trigger on new ImageKit uploads, download the image, run an NSFW check using GPT-4o vision via OpenRouter, and automatically unpublish flagged assets in ImageKit to prevent CDN delivery.

workflows.name: Placetel RAG Voice Assistant with Google Drive, Supabase and Groq
workflows.prompt: Index text files from Google Drive into a Supabase vector store using OpenAI embeddings, then answer incoming Placetel webhook questions using a Groq-hosted Llama model with retrieval-augmented generation.

workflows.name: Identify Company Decision Makers with Coresignal and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Pull company website data from Google Sheets, search for matching companies in Coresignal, find decision-maker employees, and write the resulting contact and company details back to a dedicated sheet.

workflows.name: Placetel RAG Voice Assistant with OneDrive, Supabase and Groq
workflows.prompt: Index text files from Microsoft OneDrive into a Supabase vector store using OpenAI embeddings, then answer incoming Placetel webhook questions using a Groq LLM with retrieval-augmented generation.

workflows.name: Track Etsy Competitor Listing Price Changes with Alerts
workflows.prompt: Fetch public Etsy listing details on a schedule via the Etsy Open API, store a baseline price snapshot, and trigger alerts when listing prices change beyond a configurable percentage threshold.

workflows.name: Source and Approve Emergency Equipment Rentals via Telegram and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Listen for equipment breakdown requests from a Telegram bot, email rental vendors via Gmail for quotes, compare responses using AI, and send approval links to a project manager before notifying the selected vendor and foreman.

workflows.name: Generate Construction Bid Estimates with Google Docs and Sheets
workflows.prompt: Collect a construction Scope of Work PDF via form, extract BOQ line items using AI, price them against a Google Sheets unit-rate database, generate a formatted bid report in Google Docs, log the estimate, and email the result via Gmail.

workflows.name: Translate Lab Report PDFs for Patients with Google Drive and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Watch a Google Drive folder for new lab report PDFs, extract and simplify results using OpenAI, translate the summary into the patient's preferred language, and email the formatted report via Gmail with Slack error notifications.

workflows.name: Post-Therapy Wellness Check-In Tracker with Telegram, Slack and Sheets
workflows.prompt: Send post-therapy check-in messages to patients via Telegram, analyze replies for sentiment and risk using OpenAI, alert therapists in Slack for at-risk responses, and log all results to Google Sheets for wellness tracking.

workflows.name: Send End-of-Day Operations Summaries with Google Sheets, Gemini and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Run daily at 6 PM to pull trade breaks and exceptions from Google Sheets, classify severity and trends, generate an end-of-day summary using Gemini, alert Slack for high-volume issues, email the report via Gmail, and log results back to Sheets.

workflows.name: Prioritize Exception Queues with Gemini, Google Sheets, Slack and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Trigger via webhook to read exception records from Google Sheets, rank and summarize them using Google Gemini, post a prioritized report to Slack, update summary metrics in Sheets, and send critical alerts via Gmail.

workflows.name: Promote YouTube Uploads to Social Channels with DeepSeek and Posta
workflows.prompt: Fetch the latest video from a YouTube channel RSS feed, generate platform-specific promotional captions using DeepSeek, and create draft posts in Posta for all active social media accounts.

workflows.name: Generate and Publish AI Home Cam YouTube Shorts with OpenAI and kie.ai
workflows.prompt: Run three times daily to generate an AI home cam video concept using OpenAI, create the video via kie.ai, archive it to Google Drive, upload it as a public YouTube Short, and send a confirmation email via Gmail.

workflows.name: Manage Google Calendar Events via Zalo Bot with OpenAI and Gemini
workflows.prompt: Allow users to create, update, list, or delete Google Calendar events by sending text or voice messages to a Zalo bot, transcribing voice with Gemini, processing intent with an OpenAI agent, and replying with the result in Zalo.

workflows.name: Send Portfolio Risk Reports via Google Sheets and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Accept a portfolio via webhook as a CSV or Google Sheets source, calculate allocation and concentration risk metrics, generate an HTML risk report using OpenAI, and email it via Gmail with a JSON API response.

workflows.name: Generate Incident Response Reports with Supabase and Tavily
workflows.prompt: Ingest incident and playbook content from GitHub into Supabase with pgvector embeddings, then on webhook trigger enrich incidents with historical matches, playbook routing, and live web threat intel via Tavily to generate validated incident response reports.

workflows.name: Weekly Reddit Sentiment Digest Saved to Notion
workflows.prompt: Every Monday, scrape top Reddit posts via ScraperAPI, analyze sentiment and themes with OpenAI, and compile a formatted weekly digest page in a Notion database.

workflows.name: Generate and Review Patient SOAP Notes via Gmail and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Collect patient symptoms via an n8n form, use OpenAI to draft a SOAP note, send it to a doctor for Gmail approval, save approved notes to Google Sheets, and notify via Telegram with Slack error alerts.

workflows.name: Check Prescription Safety and Drug Interactions from PDF via Telegram
workflows.prompt: Monitor a Google Drive folder for new prescription PDFs, extract text with OpenAI, check drugs against a Google Sheets formulary and interaction tables, and notify a pharmacist or patient via Telegram with Slack error alerts.

workflows.prompt: Every Friday, use Perplexity to research and propose a blog topic, write the post with Anthropic Claude, generate a cover image with Google Gemini, publish to Supabase storage, and send a notification via Gmail.

workflows.name: Sync Check Due Dates from Google Sheets to Google Calendar with Telegram Alerts
workflows.prompt: Hourly, detect updates in a Google Sheets check inventory list, create or update corresponding all-day events in Google Calendar, and post creation or update notices to a Telegram group.

workflows.prompt: On webhook trigger, scrape live job posts from Himalayas, use an LLM via NVIDIA NIM to extract required skills, compare demand against a user-defined skill list, and serve a live radar visualization of the skill gap.

workflows.prompt: Run a system prompt against a sample task using Google Gemini, have a second Gemini instance score the prompt on a 1–10 scale, and write the grade and reasoning back to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Find and Log High-Quality Domain Contacts with Tomba and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: On a schedule, pull pending company domains from Google Sheets, use Tomba to find email addresses, filter for high-scoring personal contacts, log results to an enrichment sheet, and mark domains as done.

workflows.name: Detect Duplicate Google Drive Files and Log Results to Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Scan a specified Google Drive folder for duplicate and near-duplicate filenames, log findings to Google Sheets, and optionally send a Gmail notification when duplicates are detected.

workflows.name: Send Daily Supabase Product Pulse Emails with Dynamic Metrics
workflows.prompt: Each morning, fetch your Supabase schema, use an AI model to plan safe PostgREST queries from plain-English requirements, compute the requested metrics, and email a daily pulse report via SMTP.

workflows.name: Track Phone Notification Expenses in Google Sheets with Gemini Categorization
workflows.prompt: Receive push notifications from the FlowTrigger mobile app, extract transaction amounts and dates, use Google Gemini to categorize expenses, and log each transaction to a Google Sheets ledger.

workflows.name: Send Weekly Plausible Analytics Digest to Telegram

workflows.prompt: Daily, check ClickUp tasks for inactivity based on last-updated timestamps, apply stale tags automatically, and escalate long-idle tasks by posting assignee comments.

workflows.prompt: Ingest images, PDFs, and videos from a Cloudflare R2 folder, use Google Gemini and Groq Whisper to generate descriptions and tags, and store searchable embeddings in a Supabase pgvector table.

workflows.name: Evaluate LinkedIn Profiles with Apify and AI Analysis
workflows.prompt: Scrape a LinkedIn profile URL submitted via form using Apify, analyze the profile data with a Groq-hosted Llama model, and return an HTML-formatted candidate evaluation to the user.

workflows.name: Monitor Multi-City Courier Weather Risk and Alert via Slack
workflows.prompt: Check 48-hour weather forecasts from Open-Meteo for multiple cities on a schedule, score conditions against courier-impact thresholds using OpenAI with Gemini fallback, and post operational risk alerts to a Slack channel.

workflows.name: Detect Semantic Duplicate Web Pages with Google Drive and Postgres
workflows.prompt: Scan HTML files in a Google Drive folder, extract page text into Postgres, generate vector embeddings with Ollama, run PGVector similarity searches, and produce CSV reports flagging semantically duplicate website pages.

workflows.name: Send GitHub Release Audio Newsletters via Gmail
workflows.prompt: When a GitHub release is published, convert release notes into a spoken MP3 script using OpenAI, store the audio on Google Drive, fetch subscribers from Google Sheets, and send an HTML newsletter with a listen link via Gmail.

workflows.name: Proxy OpenAI-Compatible Chat Completions to Gemini via Webhook
workflows.prompt: Expose an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions webhook endpoint that forwards requests including file attachments to a configurable LLM provider, supporting both synchronous replies and async callback-based processing.

workflows.name: Schedule Approved Notion Content Calendar Posts via Posta
workflows.prompt: Every 15 minutes, fetch approved items from a Notion content calendar database, schedule matching posts in Posta at the specified time, and update each Notion row with the Posta post URL and a Scheduled status.

workflows.name: Generate Personalized Financial Plans and Email as PDF
workflows.prompt: Receive income and financial goal data via webhook, store enriched metrics in Google Sheets, generate a tailored financial plan with Google Gemini, convert it to a PDF via PDFShift, upload to Google Drive, and email it via Gmail.

workflows.name: Evaluate AI Prompts with LLM-as-Judge and Save Reports to Notion
workflows.prompt: Collect a prompt and model choice via an n8n form, use OpenRouter LLMs to generate an evaluation dataset and grade responses against each test case, then save per-item results and a synthesized report to Notion.

workflows.name: Generate Gender-Aware Email Greetings for KlickTipp Contacts
workflows.prompt: When a contact is tagged in KlickTipp, use OpenAI to infer gender from the contact's first name or email address, then write a gender-appropriate HTML greeting back to a KlickTipp custom field.

workflows.name: Detect Maverick Spend and Alert Reviewers via Slack and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Run daily to compare procurement transactions in Google Sheets against an approved supplier list, flag unapproved spend, generate compliant alternatives with Gemini, alert reviewers via Slack and Gmail, and escalate unresolved cases after two hours.

workflows.name: Monitor Warehouse Receiving Performance with Google Sheets and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Run hourly to analyze warehouse receiving logs from Google Sheets, calculate per-user performance metrics, use Gemini to generate improvement recommendations for flagged users, and email managers via Gmail when escalation is needed.

workflows.name: Publish Science Newsletter Posts from YouTube Research to Ghost
workflows.prompt: Turn science keywords from Google Sheets into researched Ghost newsletter posts by discovering YouTube videos with Apify, validating claims via Brave Search, storing sources in Qdrant, drafting content with an LLM, and publishing via Ghost.

workflows.name: Post Daily Motivational Quote Images to Telegram
workflows.prompt: Run daily to generate a motivational quote with Google Gemini, render it as an image using htmlcsstoimg.com, and post the resulting photo to a Telegram channel.

workflows.name: Send SAP Business One Order and Invoice Alerts via WhatsApp

workflows.name: Extract Technical Glossary Terms from Meeting Transcripts and Send to Telegram
workflows.prompt: Accept a meeting transcript via form or webhook, use Claude to extract technical terms and acronyms into a structured JSON glossary, and send the formatted glossary or a confirmation message to Telegram.

workflows.prompt: Daily workflow that reads patient vitals from Google Sheets, scores risk against AHA/ADA thresholds, and sends escalation alerts to clinicians via Telegram and Gmail while logging all results back to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Telehealth Appointment No-Show Risk Scoring with Telegram and Google Calendar
workflows.prompt: Collect telehealth appointment submissions via an n8n Form, score no-show risk using OpenAI, send Telegram reminders to patients, and update Google Calendar based on patient responses with Slack error alerts.

workflows.prompt: Ingest agent skills into Cognee, automatically review performance against a score threshold, propose rewrites for underperforming skills, and require human approval of the before/after diff before applying changes.

workflows.name: Telegram Fitness and Nutrition Coach with Google Sheets and Calendar
workflows.prompt: Turn a Telegram chat into a French-speaking fitness and nutrition coach that transcribes voice notes via OpenAI, responds using Anthropic, logs training and nutrition data in Google Sheets, and schedules workouts in Google Calendar.

workflows.name: Generate Personalized Franchise PDF Letters from Excel via Google Docs
workflows.prompt: Accept an uploaded XLSX list of franchise owners via an n8n form, generate a personalized letter for each row using Google Docs templates, and save the resulting PDFs to a Google Drive folder.

workflows.prompt: Scrape accommodation listings from Booking.com using Apify, enrich them with Google Maps contact details and website scraping, then append the finalized partner lead list to a Google Sheets spreadsheet.

workflows.name: Send Portfolio Risk Reports from Google Sheets via Gmail
workflows.prompt: Collect a portfolio analysis request via an n8n Form, load holdings from Google Sheets, calculate risk and concentration metrics, generate an HTML narrative using OpenAI, and email the full report via Gmail with an audit log entry.

workflows.name: Detect Visual Regressions with Apify, Gemini Vision, and Linear
workflows.prompt: Capture baseline website screenshots with Apify stored in Google Drive, then run scheduled comparisons against new screenshots using Google Gemini Vision and automatically create a Linear issue when visual regressions are detected.

workflows.name: Enrich Company Records with Social Media URLs Using Supabase
workflows.prompt: Pull company records from Supabase, use an OpenAI agent to crawl each company website and extract social media profile URLs, then write the enriched records back to Supabase.

workflows.name: Scrape Hacker News Hiring Threads and Save Job Posts to Airtable
workflows.prompt: Find the latest Hacker News 'Who is Hiring?' thread via Algolia, fetch all job comments from the Firebase API, structure each posting into fields using OpenAI, and save the results to Airtable.

workflows.name: Index and Query Financial Documents with Qdrant and Mistral
workflows.prompt: Ingest local financial documents into a Qdrant vector database using Mistral embeddings, keeping the index in sync by handling file additions, changes, and deletions.

workflows.name: Trigger Coolify Deployments from Docker Hub and GHCR Image Updates
workflows.prompt: Monitor Docker Hub and GitHub Container Registry (GHCR) image tags on a schedule, detect new digests, and automatically trigger Coolify API restarts for mapped services to deploy the latest images.

workflows.name: Generate FAQ MP3 Library from Form Input via Google Drive and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Accept FAQ question-and-answer pairs from an n8n Form, convert each pair to MP3 using OpenAI TTS, upload files to Google Drive, log links in Google Sheets, and email a summary with listen and download links via Gmail.

workflows.name: Send Portfolio Contact Form Notifications and Confirmations via Gmail
workflows.prompt: Receive portfolio contact form submissions via webhook, normalize fields, and use Gmail to send branded HTML admin notifications and automated visitor confirmation emails.

workflows.name: Capture and Log Email Trade Instructions via Gmail and Google Sheets
workflows.prompt: Poll Gmail for emails with a specific trade instruction subject, extract structured trade fields using OpenAI, log valid and failed extractions to separate Google Sheets tabs, and send confirmation and ops alert emails via Gmail.

workflows.name: Sync Etsy Customers with Meta Custom Audiences Using Hashed Emails
workflows.prompt: Run daily to fetch recent Etsy receipt emails via a sub-workflow, SHA-256 hash the normalized emails, and upload them to a Meta Custom Audience using the Meta Graph API.

workflows.name: Generate Workflow Audit Documentation with Claude and Notion
workflows.prompt: Collect an exported n8n workflow JSON via a form, audit it for reliability and security issues, use Anthropic Claude to draft a business summary and technical report, and create a formatted documentation page in Notion.

workflows.name: Retrieve Xiaohongshu Comment Reply Threads via JustOneAPI
workflows.prompt: Fetch reply threads for a specific Xiaohongshu comment using JustOneAPI to track conversations, analyze audience interactions, and monitor community discussions.

workflows.name: Resolve Xiaohongshu Share Links to Final URLs via JustOneAPI
workflows.prompt: Resolve Xiaohongshu short share links to their final redirect URLs using JustOneAPI for use in content research, link normalization, and downstream automation workflows.

workflows.name: Expand Xiaohongshu Keywords into Suggestions via JustOneAPI
workflows.prompt: Send a seed keyword to the Xiaohongshu Keyword Suggestions endpoint via JustOneAPI and return structured keyword expansion results for content planning and topic research.

workflows.name: Recommend TikTok Sound and Caption Packs for Product Videos

workflows.name: Attach a Fixed TikTok Sound to Downstream Content Workflows

workflows.name: Fetch Taobao and Tmall Product Reviews via JustOneAPI
workflows.prompt: Retrieve and structure buyer reviews for a specified Taobao or Tmall product using the JustOneAPI integration inside n8n.

workflows.name: Fetch Taobao and Tmall Shop Products and Details with JustOneAPI
workflows.prompt: Retrieve a product list from a Taobao or Tmall shop via JustOneAPI, extract the first product ID, and fetch its full detail data for ecommerce research or marketplace analysis.

workflows.name: Search Douyin Videos by Keyword and Fetch First Video Details
workflows.prompt: Search Douyin videos by a given keyword using JustOneAPI, retrieve the first matching video's ID, and fetch its full detail data for content research or marketing analysis.

workflows.name: Search Douyin Users by Keyword and Fetch Profile Details via JustOneAPI
workflows.prompt: Search Douyin users by keyword using JustOneAPI's Search User endpoint, extract SecUID identifiers from results, and fetch structured profile details for creator research or marketing analysis.

workflows.name: Get Douyin User Published Videos and First Video Details via JustOneAPI
workflows.prompt: Retrieve a Douyin user's published video list using their SecUID via JustOneAPI, then fetch full detail data for the first video for creator research or content operations.

workflows.name: Get Douyin Video Comments and Replies with JustOneAPI
workflows.prompt: Fetch Douyin video comments and reply threads using JustOneAPI, starting from a video ID and collecting nested reply data for content analysis.

workflows.name: Indian Tender Email Reports from TendersInfo.net
workflows.prompt: Fetch live government tenders from TendersInfo.net based on keywords, filter for GEM and MSE-eligible opportunities, and generate a formatted HTML email report grouped by company.

workflows.prompt: Poll Sharetribe for transaction transition events, filter for confirmed payments, fetch full transaction details, and notify a marketplace admin via Gmail.

workflows.name: Collect Astrology Feedback via Telegram Multi-Step Bot with Supabase
workflows.prompt: Run a Telegram bot that guides users through a multi-step astrology reading request flow, persisting session state in Supabase and logging completed requests to a Supabase history table.

workflows.name: WTI Crude Futures Price Tracker with Telegram Alerts
workflows.prompt: On a weekday schedule, scrape WTI crude oil futures prices from Oilprice.com, parse contract symbols, months, prices, and changes from the HTML, and send a formatted market snapshot to a Telegram chat.

workflows.name: Murban Crude Futures Price Alerts via Telegram
workflows.prompt: On a scheduled weekday basis aligned with market hours, fetch Murban crude futures data from OilPrice.com, format a forward-curve report into HTML, and send the alert to a Telegram chat.

workflows.name: Kuaishou Video Details Retrieval by Keyword with JustOneAPI
workflows.prompt: Use JustOneAPI to search Kuaishou videos by keyword and retrieve structured video detail data including metadata and engagement metrics for content research and analysis.

workflows.name: Expose CoinGecko Crypto Data Tools via MCP Server
workflows.prompt: Expose CoinGecko data retrieval as an MCP server in n8n so that MCP clients can fetch coin details, prices, tickers, market charts, candlesticks, history, and events via a single webhook-based trigger.

workflows.name: Monitor AI Gateway Budget Usage and Send Overspend Alerts via Gmail
workflows.prompt: Every 6 hours, check an Alephant AI Gateway virtual key's budget usage and send a detailed overspend alert email via Gmail when usage meets or exceeds the configured threshold.

workflows.name: Research Kuaishou Creator Profiles by Keyword with JustOneAPI
workflows.prompt: Search Kuaishou creators by keyword using JustOneAPI and return structured creator profile data for research and marketing teams inside n8n.

workflows.name: Research Kuaishou Creator Videos by Keyword with JustOneAPI
workflows.prompt: Search Kuaishou creators by keyword using JustOneAPI and return a structured list of their published videos for creator research and marketing teams inside n8n.

workflows.name: Collect and Structure Kuaishou Video Comments via JustOneAPI
workflows.prompt: Use JustOneAPI to fetch structured comment data from a specified Kuaishou video and collect the results inside an n8n workflow for further analysis or storage.

workflows.name: Create Karaoke Instrumental Tracks Using StemSplit and Google Drive
workflows.prompt: Accept a song URL and email via an n8n form, remove vocals using StemSplit AI, upload the resulting MP3 to Google Drive, and email the requester a download link with automatic error notifications for invalid URLs or insufficient credits.

workflows.name: Score BizQuest Business Listings and Alert Top Deals in Slack
workflows.prompt: Daily, scrape BizQuest listings via Apify, deduplicate against a Google Sheet, score buyer fit using Claude, generate broker outreach copy for high-fit deals, send formatted Slack alerts, and log all scored listings to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Send Weekly Taiwan Foreign Institutional Flow Report to Telegram
workflows.prompt: Run every Monday to pull TWSE T86 institutional trading data, aggregate foreign investor net flows into weekly leaders and streaks, and send a plain-text report to a Telegram chat.

workflows.name: Approve or Reject Dokan Marketplace Vendors from Slack
workflows.prompt: Poll Dokan for newly registered vendors awaiting approval, post each pending vendor to a Slack channel with Approve/Reject buttons, and update the vendor's status in Dokan based on admin clicks.

workflows.name: Send Transactional SMS via OVHcloud SMS API
workflows.prompt: Sign and send a transactional SMS to a specified phone number using the OVHcloud SMS API with application credentials and SHA1-based request authentication.

workflows.name: Update VNTANA Product Attributes from Scheduled Excel Attachments
workflows.prompt: Check a VNTANA product every 15 minutes for a new XLSX attachment with a defined filename prefix, read attribute key-value rows from the spreadsheet, and replace the product's attributes in VNTANA with the file's data.

workflows.name: Quantum Fabrication QA Monitor with Multi-Agent AI and Alerts
workflows.prompt: Run multi-agent OpenAI analysis every 30 minutes across quantum fabrication metrics including device performance, defect detection, and supply chain, synthesize results into a structured QA report saved to an n8n Data Table, and send critical alerts via HTTP.

workflows.name: SMC Screener Analysis Manager via n8n Forms and HTTP API
workflows.prompt: Accept SMC Screener API credentials and actions via an n8n form, then call the SMC Screener Analysis API to list, create, update, reanalyze, or delete analyses and return structured response summaries.

workflows.name: Enrich German Vocabulary List in Google Sheets with Synonyms and Example Sentences
workflows.prompt: Monitor a Google Sheets vocabulary list for new German words, look up synonyms via OpenThesaurus, generate a JSON-formatted example sentence using OpenAI, and write the enriched data back to the same sheet.

workflows.name: Clean Up Watched Jellyfin Media and Completed Torrents with Transmission
workflows.prompt: Run daily to fetch played movies and episodes from Jellyfin, delete them via the Jellyfin API, refresh the library, and remove completed torrents including local data from Transmission.

workflows.name: Predict Airport Queue Wait Times and Send Email Alerts with OpenAI and SendGrid
workflows.prompt: Accept traveler flight details via webhook or on a schedule, predict airport queue wait times using a JavaScript model, generate an alert message with OpenAI, send it via SendGrid, and log the prediction to Google Sheets.

workflows.name: Verify Australian Supplier ABNs with ABR, Google Sheets and Gmail
workflows.prompt: Collect supplier onboarding details via an n8n Form, verify the ABN against the Australian Business Register API, save approved suppliers to Google Sheets, notify the team via Gmail, and display a success or rejection page to the supplier.

workflows.name: Approve or Reject Dokan Marketplace Vendors from Telegram
workflows.prompt: Poll Dokan marketplace for pending vendors, post each new vendor to Telegram with Approve/Reject actions, update vendor status in Dokan via token-protected webhooks, and confirm the result back in Telegram.

workflows.name: Margin-Aware Paid AI Agent with Alephant and Discord
workflows.prompt: Expose a paid-per-call webhook endpoint that verifies budget via Alephant analytics, routes requests through an OpenAI agent selecting the most cost-effective model, tracks costs via Alephant, and reports per-call margins to Discord.

workflows.name: Maritime Route Optimization and Disruption Response via Slack
workflows.prompt: Every 15 minutes, fetch vessel telemetry and AIS data, enrich it with weather and port congestion context, use OpenAI to detect disruptions and simulate route alternatives, then send an executive briefing requiring human approval before notifying teams in Slack.

workflows.name: Multi-Agent Energy Optimization Orchestration
workflows.prompt: Orchestrate multi-agent analysis for a thermodynamic system using OpenAI and Anthropic models to interpret sensor inputs, optimize energy usage, plan and execute tasks, validate results, and send an HTTP alert if validation fails.

workflows.name: Export WordPress Data to CSV File
workflows.prompt: Manually fetch all records from a WordPress site via the WordPress API, convert the JSON response into a CSV file, and save it to the n8n server.

workflows.name: Send Daily World Cup 2026 Briefings to Slack
workflows.prompt: Run daily to fetch FIFA World Cup 2026 fixtures, standings, and stadium data from an API, generate a localized next-day briefing using OpenAI, and post it to a Slack channel.

workflows.name: Analyze Inflation Hedges and Email Report via Gmail
workflows.prompt: Calculate inflation-adjusted real returns for a set of commodities versus a savings rate, generate a structured analysis using OpenAI, and email the final report via Gmail.

workflows.name: Create work4all Incoming Invoices from Outlook Supplier Emails

workflows.name: Audit Competitor Etsy Catalogs and Track Listing Changes

workflows.prompt: Submit a topic, slide count, audience, tone, and outline hints to Encelade to generate a presentation deck, poll for completion, and return the finished deck link.

workflows.prompt: Expose a POST webhook that accepts base64 CAPTCHA images, solve multiple CAPTCHA types using CaptchaSonic, and return a standardized JSON response.

workflows.name: Run LDXhub Document Processing Jobs from a Single Form
workflows.prompt: Provide a single n8n form that routes document processing jobs to five LDXhub services (StructFlow, RefineLoop, RenderOCR, CastDoc, ExtractDoc) and returns the generated output file directly to the user.

workflows.name: Log Strava Zone 2 and 5K Test Runs to Google Sheets

workflows.name: Get Forum Details from Disqus
workflows.prompt: Retrieve details about a specific Disqus forum, including metadata and settings, using the Disqus integration.

workflows.name: Send Memes via Discord

workflows.prompt: Demonstrate basic text manipulation and processing concepts in n8n for Spanish-speaking beginners following a step-by-step tutorial.

workflows.prompt: Accept structured scripture reference input, query the GetBible API, and return standardized JSON scripture data for use in other workflows.

workflows.prompt: Set up a webhook endpoint that triggers a call to the Dog CEO API and returns a random dog image URL, suitable for fun integrations or testing webhook-based workflows.
